descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
As a key member of our Android team, you will play a vital role in developing and maintaining the Hinge Android mobile application. Your focus will be on implementing new product features, fixing issues, and improving the mobile application user experience. All while leveraging the latest Android tools such as Kotlin, jetpack compose, coroutines, room, hilt and many more. Collaborating within a cross-disciplinary team, including product managers, technical project managers, designers, data engineers, backend engineers, and QA specialists, you will work closely with the Tech Lead and peers to advance our product and contribute to our engineering community. This role offers the opportunity to do high-impact work, directly contributing to a consumer mobile application used by millions. Over time you can expect to grow into an independent, capable, and confident Android developer.

lists.content:
• Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with a diverse team of developers, designers, and product managers to build features that prioritize high quality and user engagement.
  • Kotlin Proficiency: Develop and continuously enhance your understanding of Kotlin fundamentals, applying them to create efficient and effective solutions.
  • Android Expertise: Gain a thorough understanding of Android development principles and design patterns, applying them to build intuitive and user-friendly applications.
  • Issue Resolution: Triage, debug, and effectively resolve software issues, ensuring the stability and performance of our application.
  • Codebase Stewardship: Actively contribute to the long-term health and evolution of the codebase, implementing best practices and innovative solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Regularly perform code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Active Team Participation: Engage actively in team ceremonies such as stand-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives to ensure alignment and promote agile methodologies.
  • Effective Communication: Maintain clear and positive communication with team members and other departments, supporting an empowering and inclusive team environment.

• Professional Android Development Experience: You have 3-5 years of experience in Android development, demonstrating the ability to design and implement mobile applications effectively.
  • Google Play Publication: You have experience publishing at least one application on the Google Play Store, showcasing your understanding of the deployment process and maintaining a production application.
  • Proficiency in Kotlin and Android SDKs: You are proficient in Kotlin, which is strongly preferred, and have a good understanding of Android SDKs and frameworks. Experience with Java in the context of Android development is also beneficial.
  • Solid Software Development Fundamentals: You possess a good foundation in software development principles and are capable of creating efficient and maintainable code.
  • Strong Communication Skills: You are able to communicate clearly and effectively, facilitating productive collaborations within technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ownership and Quality Focus: You take pride in your work and are committed to creating high-quality user experiences, demonstrating attention to detail and a user-centric approach to application development.

descriptionPlain:
- Legal Entity: Hyperconnect
- Brand: Tinder
 
 
About Tinder
 
Tinder connects people. 
With tens of millions of users and a presence in nearly every country on Earth, our reach is expansive—and growing fast.
 
The Globalization team sits within Product Operations and plays a critical role in shaping how we connect with people worldwide. We enable culturally relevant, hyper-localized experiences by partnering across product, design, content, and marketing to ensure Tinder resonates across borders and languages.
 
 
About the Role
 
We’re looking for an experienced and strategically minded Senior Localization Program Manager to drive Tinder’s localization efforts across APAC.
 
Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Globalization & International Growth, this role will work closely with another Program Manager to operationalize the team’s global strategy within the region — ensuring our products, content, and campaigns are not just translated, but truly built for local relevance and impact.
 
You’ll serve as a regional program lead, connecting cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design to integrate localization early in development, optimize workflows, and surface insights that inform global decisions.
 
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of program management, technical localization, and cultural strategy, and who can scale processes across multiple markets while staying attuned to local nuance.

lists.content:
• Drive regional localization execution and strategy alignment: Own the end-to-end localization program for APAC, translating global strategy into regional priorities and scalable programs.
  • Act as a regional thought partner: Collaborate with the Sr. Manager of Globalization and the broader Globalization team to shape initiatives that advance Tinder’s global readiness and user experience.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Build strong relationships with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, and Data to integrate localization into roadmaps and launch cycles, influencing decisions with regional insights.
  • Partner with regional Marketing leads and the VP of APAC Marketing to support Go-To-Market Asia efforts—ensuring on-time delivery of localized assets, efficient production workflows, and seamless execution of high-impact campaigns across markets.
  • Optimize localization operations: Assess and refine workflows, tools, and automation (TMS, CAT, QA automation, connectors) to enhance efficiency, transparency, and quality.
  • Support internationalization efforts: Partner with engineering to identify and address i18n issues, ensuring scalability and long-term product readiness across languages.
  • Program governance: Establish and track KPIs to measure localization performance, cost efficiency, and quality outcomes.
  • Vendor and resource management: Oversee localization vendors and freelance linguists, driving accountability, innovation, and high-quality output.
  • Mentorship and enablement: Collaborate closely with Language Managers and other Program Managers to ensure alignment, mentorship, and consistent process execution across regions.
  • Cultural intelligence: Stay ahead of cultural trends, linguistic shifts, and user behaviors across APAC markets to guide creative and product decisions.
    •

• 5+ years of experience in localization program management, international operations, or a related function within a tech, product, or global brand environment.
  • Proven success managing complex, multi-market localization programs across APAC.
  • Deep understanding of localization technology ecosystems (TMS, CAT, QA automation) and internationalization fundamentals.
  • Strong program management skills — from scoping and prioritization to stakeholder communication and risk mitigation.
  • Experience influencing product and marketing decisions through data, insights, and user empathy.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills and a collaborative mindset; comfortable working across technical and creative teams.
  • Self-starter with strong ownership, adaptability, and attention to detail.
  • Fluent in English
    •

• Experience localizing mobile apps or digital platforms, particularly in dating, social, or lifestyle categories.
  • Familiarity with Tinder’s tone, brand voice, and youth culture positioning.
  • Technical literacy in APIs, localization connectors, or automation scripting.
  • Fluency in at least one APAC language (e.g., Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Hindi, etc.).
  • Experience supporting go-to-market or regional marketing campaigns across diverse APAC markets.

descriptionPlain:
At Meetic, a Match Group company, we have been pioneering online dating for over 20 years, leveraging our legacy to reinvent how people meet, connect, and build meaningful relationships across Europe and beyond. 
As part of Match Group, we manage a diverse portfolio of brands, from iconic names like Meetic, Match, Lexa, and LoveScout24 to tailored experiences for singles over 50, OurTime, DisonsDemain, Zweisam, and single parents, Even and Stir. 

Our teams design, build, and scale platforms across 20+ countries and 18 languages, ensuring every single finds the right match for their lifestyle and lifestages. We also drive growth for other Match Group brands like The League, OkCupid, Archer, Salams, and Plenty Of Fish, expanding our impact worldwide.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days / week in our office, 53 rue de Chateaudun, 75009 Paris.


Role overview :
As a Junior Brand Copywriter Apprentice, you'll help shape the voice of some of Europe's most iconic dating brands, including Meetic. Working closely with the Senior Brand Copywriter, you'll create compelling content across a wide range of touchpoints, contribute to the evolution of our brand identities, and collaborate with international teams, freelance copywriters, and translation partners. From CRM campaigns and app copy to brand guidelines and creative concepts, no two days are the same.
 
How you’ll make an impact :
Write engaging, on-brand copy across multiple channels and customer touchpoints.
Help maintain and evolve our editorial guidelines to keep our brands consistent and distinctive.
Support content trans-creation from English into French while preserving each brand's tone of voice.
Collaborate with freelance copywriters, translation partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality content.
Stay on top of creative, cultural, and digital trends to bring fresh ideas to the team.
 
We could be a match if :  
You're currently studying Communications, Marketing, Advertising, Languages, or a related field, and are looking for a 12-month apprenticeship.
You have excellent writing skills in French, with strong attention to spelling, grammar, and style.
You're fluent in English and comfortable trans-creating content into French.
You have an interest in digital marketing (CRM, SEO, social media, etc.) and brand communication.
You're curious, creative, organized, proactive, and enjoy collaborating with others.
 
What’s the team like ?
You'll join the Creative Lab within our Marketing team and report directly to the Senior Brand Copywriter. Working alongside designers and project managers, you'll thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where curiosity, collaboration, and bold ideas are encouraged. Success in this role means bringing our brands to life through impactful copy, contributing fresh thinking, and becoming a trusted copywriting partner for teams across Europe. 
 

Interview Process:
A first 30 min Zoom conversation with Fatima-Ezzahra Abidi (Talent Acquisition Specialist).
A 45 min onsite or Zoom meeting with Jessica Serviat (Senior Brand Copywriter).
A 30 min Zoom conversation with a member of the Design team.

descriptionPlain:
At Meetic, a Match Group company, we have been pioneering online dating for over 20 years, leveraging our legacy to reinvent how people meet, connect, and build meaningful relationships across Europe and beyond. 
As part of Match Group, we manage a diverse portfolio of brands, from iconic names like Meetic, Match, Lexa, and LoveScout24 to tailored experiences for singles over 50, OurTime, DisonsDemain, Zweisam, and single parents, Even and Stir. 

Our teams design, build, and scale platforms across 20+ countries and 18 languages, ensuring every single finds the right match for their lifestyle and lifestages. We also drive growth for other Match Group brands like The League, OkCupid, Archer, Salams, and Plenty Of Fish, expanding our impact worldwide.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days / week in our office, 53 rue de Chateaudun, 75009 Paris.


Role overview : 
As an apprentice within the Creative Lab, you'll be embedded in the design team and mentored by a senior lead. You'll contribute to real, high-stakes projects with progressive autonomy throughout the year. The goal is to grow you technically, methodologically, and in your cross-functional collaboration skills.
Because we work very closely with the Marketing teams (Acquisition, Brand, SEO/ASO, CRM, Media) you'll build a strong digital expertise as part of the role: understanding acquisition metrics, performance-driven design, the mechanics of how modern brands operate across channels, and how creative choices translate into business impact.
How you’ll make an impact :
Support the Marketing teams by creating digital content (animated and static) that match with performance or image objectives (from storyboard to editing).
Work closely with the product team to infuse Brand Identity in the user experience.
Be the guardian of our Brand identities, bring it to life on all creative assets and make it evolve.
Contribute to the team's key strategic projects: rebrandings, new brand territories, feature launches.

We could be a match if :
You are a student from a design school, multimedia creation or graphic arts.
You are looking for a 1 or 2-year apprenticeship, starting September 2026.
You are learning to use Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Figma (mandatory).
Big plus if you have notions of Premiere Pro, photography, 3D, illustration or in AI.
You are creative, curious, rigorous and well-organized.
You speak English (French is not mandatory) and have a strong digital appetite!
You really appreciate teamwork and like to share your inspirations!
What’s the team like ?
The Creative Lab is Match Group E&E's in-house creative team. We own the visual production across several brands in the portfolio.
The team is multidisciplinary (concept, design, motion, production, copywriting, photography, 3D…) and works across all brand touchpoints: acquisition, ASO, brand platform, CRM, events, partner activations and, increasingly, product experience.
Our culture: rigour, high standards on execution, structured workflows, a strong culture of care and mutual respect, active openness to new tools, and a genuine test & learn mindset. We ship, we learn, we iterate.
Interview Process :
A first 30 min Zoom conversation with Fatima-Ezzahra Abidi (Talent Acquisition Specialist).
A 60 min onsite or Zoom meeting with Thomas Smaïl (Senior Brand Designer).
A 30 min onsite or Zoom interview with Mathieu Pecquenard (Sr. Manager, Creative Lab).

Role overview :
As a Junior Marketing Assistant Apprentice, you will join our Marketing team and gain hands-on experience across a wide range of marketing activities. Working alongside experienced marketers, you will support the execution of 360° marketing campaigns for the French market, equally Meetic and DisonsDemain, while developing your skills across brand marketing, communications, content, partnerships and social media.
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days / week in our office, 53 rue de Chateaudun, 75009 Paris.
 
How you’ll make an impact:
Marketing :
Support the Senior Marketing Manager in the execution of local marketing initiatives
Assist in coordinating local marketing campaigns across Brand and Acquisition teams
Help monitor campaign performance and identify key learnings
Conduct competitor and market research to support strategic recommendations
Contribute to the preparation of the annual Integrated Marketing Plan
Communications :
Help develop creative communication ideas to strengthen brand awareness & consideration in France
Collaborate with our local PR agency and support the execution of PR initiatives
Review, edit, and contribute to press releases and editorial materials
Support the coordination and execution of partnership projects.
Assist in preparing creative briefs for agencies, media partners and content creators
Content & Social Media :
Help ensure each brand's tone of voice is applied consistently across communications
Support the planning and creation of engaging social media content
Assist with copywriting and content creation across digital channels.
Coordinate with the Creative Lab on visual asset production

We could be a match if : 
Native French speaker with a strong understanding of French culture; comfortable communicating in English (written and spoken).
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an interest in PR, content and social media.
Interest in social media, PR and influencer marketing 
Curious, analytical and eager to learn, with an interest in using data to understand campaign performance.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Open-minded, adaptable, curious, connected to trend/lifestyle & cultural topics
First experience (internship, student project or association) in marketing, communications or social media is a plus
 
What’s the team like?
You'll report to the Senior Marketing Managers France and work closely with Brand, Acquisition and Creative Lab teams, as well as external agencies and partners. The team combines creativity with data-driven decision making and offers a collaborative environment where you'll learn, contribute and grow through meaningful marketing projects.
Interview Process:
A first 30min Zoom interview with Fatima-Ezzahra Abidi (Talent Acquisition Specialist).
A 60 min onsite meeting with the hiring manager Maïlys Mertian (Sr. Marketing Manager) and/or MarieDEMEIRE (Sr. Marketing Manager).
A 30 min Zoom interview with Anna Robbert (Global Marketing Director).

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days / week in our office, 53 rue de Chateaudun, 75009 Paris.
 
How you’ll make an impact:
Marketing :
Support the Senior Marketing Manager in the execution of local marketing initiatives
Assist in coordinating local marketing campaigns across Brand and Acquisition teams
Help monitor campaign performance and identify key learnings
Conduct competitor and market research to support strategic recommendations
Contribute to the preparation of the annual Integrated Marketing Plan
Communications :
Help develop creative communication ideas to strengthen brand awareness & consideration in France
Collaborate with our local PR agency and support the execution of PR initiatives
Review, edit, and contribute to press releases and editorial materials
Support the coordination and execution of partnership projects.
Assist in preparing creative briefs for agencies, media partners and content creators
Content & Social Media :
Help ensure each brand's tone of voice is applied consistently across communications
Support the planning and creation of engaging social media content
Assist with copywriting and content creation across digital channels.
Coordinate with the Creative Lab on visual asset production

We could be a match if : 
Native French speaker with a strong understanding of French culture; comfortable communicating in English (written and spoken).
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an interest in PR, content and social media.
Interest in social media, PR and influencer marketing 
Curious, analytical and eager to learn, with an interest in using data to understand campaign performance.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Open-minded, adaptable, curious, connected to trend/lifestyle & cultural topics
First experience (internship, student project or association) in marketing, communications or social media is a plus
 
What’s the team like?
You'll report to the Senior Marketing Managers France and work closely with Brand, Acquisition and Creative Lab teams, as well as external agencies and partners. descriptionPlain:
At Meetic, a Match Group company, we have been pioneering online dating for over 20 years, leveraging our legacy to reinvent how people meet, connect, and build meaningful relationships across Europe and beyond. 
As part of Match Group, we manage a diverse portfolio of brands, from iconic names like Meetic, Match, Lexa, and LoveScout24 to tailored experiences for singles over 50, OurTime, DisonsDemain, Zweisam, and single parents, Even and Stir. 

Our teams design, build, and scale platforms across 20+ countries and 18 languages, ensuring every single finds the right match for their lifestyle and lifestages. We also drive growth for other Match Group brands like The League, OkCupid, Archer, Salams, and Plenty Of Fish, expanding our impact worldwide.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days / week in our office, 53 rue de Chateaudun, 75009 Paris.


Role overview :

As an Online Acquisition Apprentice, you’ll support the team in accelerating paid growth across our global portfolio of dating apps. Working closely with both the creative team and media partners, you’ll help develop and optimize acquisition strategies, contribute to campaign planning and performance analysis, and gain hands-on experience in traffic management in a dynamic, data-driven marketing environment. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how online acquisition drives business impact at scale.

How you’ll make an impact:
Help grow online acquisition across multiple dating apps and markets.
Share creative feedback and reports to improve ad performance.
Spot and launch new media partners to expand reach.
 
We could be a match if:
You are a Bachelor's or Master's student seeking an apprenticeship, ideally with a 3-weeks-in-company / 1-week-at-school schedule, but we warmly welcome other formats.
You have hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads platforms. Affiliation will be a plus.
You’re curious, proactive, rigorous, and open-minded.
You’re comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets.
You enjoy collaborating with creative, tracking, and media partner teams.
Your familiarity with AI / LLM tools is a plus.
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

What’s the team like?
You’ll report to a Team Lead Online Marketing and join a collaborative, data-driven and multicultural team.
You will work closely with the rest of the acquisition team with different expertise, and the creative teams. 
 
Interview Process:
A first 30 min Zoom conversation with Fatima-Ezzahra Abidi (Talent Acquisition Specialist).
A 60 onsite meeting with Yanjun Shi (Team Lead Online Marketing) including a case study.
A 60 min onsite or Zoom interview with Florent Maucourt (Sr. Online Marketing Manager) and Céline Ben Haddou (People Business Partner).

descriptionPlain:
エウレカは、真剣にパートナーを見つけたいと考えている方に向けた恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営している会社です。
Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,700万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版、2025年に韓国版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、70万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。
2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを。」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。
 
 
Job Summary:
UTH (Under The Hood) Backend TeamはPairs本体の機能開発を支えるマイクロサービス・関連コンポーネント等の基盤の提供や、アプリケーションセキュリティ・開発生産性・品質の改善などの遂行等を通して、堅牢で拡張性のある基盤を構築し、Pairsをより成長に導くことを目的にしています。 

UTH Backend Teamはユーザー向けに直接的な機能の提供・開発は行いませんが、職責上、開発組織が幅広い分野でエンジニアリングを活かした活躍をする事が可能です。
 
 
What You’ll Do:
・機能開発において汎用的に利用するマイクロサービスの開発
・ユーザー向けの直接的なフィーチャー開発を主とするプロダクトバックエンドチームと協調した品質改善や開発効率改善
・SREチームと協調したインフラレイヤーと協調する応答性能やスループットの改善
・中規模以上(半年〜)の期間が必要となるミドルウェアのアップデートや汎用的に利用する基盤開発
・セキュリティチームと協調したアプリケーションセキュリティの向上の取り組み
 
これらの取り組みを通じて、エンジニアとして多岐にわたる経験を積みながら、プロダクトと開発組織を共に強化する機会を得られます。

  • Traceやprofilerを利用したレイテンシやスループットなどの改善経験

  • コンテナ環境におけるアプリケーションのデプロイスクリプトやdockerfileの構築

  • AWS/Google CloudなどPublic Cloud上でのインフラ構築の経験や知識

  • Webアプリケーションにおける基本的なセキュリティ対策・必要性などの知識

• Programming Languages: Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python

  • Tech Stack:  MySQL,DynamoDB,Redis,Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, various AWS and Google Cloud services,Terraform

  • Development: Git,Github,GithubActions,Docker,Jira Cloud,Slack

lists.content:
• 開発効率改善やパフォーマンス改善やセキュリティ対応等に強い意欲を持つ事

  • 関係者を効果的に巻き込み、成果を上げるためのオーナーシップとコミュニケーションスキル

  • AI周りのキャッチアップ・学習意欲がある・Coding Agentを使って開発した経験

  • 3年以上の商用アプリケーションの実装・リリース・運用の経験

  • AWS/Google CloudなどのPublic Cloud上で動作する商用のWebAPIを構築した経験

  • 各種テスト手法についての構築・設計経験

  • Webアプリケーションの商用コンテナイメージの作成〜運用の経験 (dockerfileや必要なmiddlewareのinstallなど)

  • Nginx, MySQLなどWebアプリケーションによく用いられるミドルウェアについての最低限の知識

  • 日本語：ビジネスレベル以上・英語：会話レベル以上

• 不正利用、悪用、ポリシー違反などの変化の速いリスク領域において、ユーザー行動やシステムログ、施策結果などのデータを自ら分析し、リスクの兆候や傾向、施策の有効性を評価しながら、検知・予防・対応の仕組みを継続的に改善した経験

  • Data Analystの支援を必要に応じて受けながらも、一定の範囲では自らデータを抽出・集計・分析し、課題の規模感、優先度、実装すべき対策の妥当性、施策の効果を評価できること

  • 対象となるユーザー行動やリスクパターンが短期間で変化し続ける環境において、自ら分析・評価を行い、その結果をもとに開発・改善につなげた経験

  • 大規模データ・アクセス数を考慮したスケーラビリティをもったデータベース・アプリケーションの設計経験・知識

  • AI開発支援ツールを活用した開発フロー・コード品質・ドキュメント作成・チームの生産性向上に取り組んだ経験

  • コンテナ環境におけるアプリケーションのデプロイスクリプトやdockerfileの構築

  • AWS/Google CloudなどPublic Cloudのインフラ構築の経験や知識

  • Webアプリケーションにおける基本的なセキュリティ対策・必要性などの知識

• Programming Languages: Go, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python

  • Tech Stack:  MySQL,DynamoDB,Redis,Elasticsearch, Kubernetes,and various AWS and Google Cloud services,Terraform

  • Development: Git,Github,GithubActions,Docker,Jira Cloud,Slack

lists.content:
• 아자르 사용자에 대한 모든 커뮤니케이션 채널 및 콘텐츠 관리 (고객센터를 제외한 팝업, 배너, 앱내 알림센터, 푸시, 이메일 등 모든 채널)
  • 주요 서비스 지표(engagement, retention, revenue 등)의 상승을 위한 CRM 전략 로드맵 수립 및 실행
  • 제품분석팀과 협업하여 사용자 여정의 각 퍼널을 면밀히 분석하고 개선 계획을 수립
  • 최적의 User Journey를 위한 각 세그먼트별 유저 메시지 작성 및 리스크 검토
  • 개발팀과의 협업을 통해 필요한 지원을 받아 CRM 로드맵을 실행하고 iteration을 통해 개선
  • 개발팀과의 협업을 통한 내부 CRM 시스템 개선

lists.content:
• Product Analytics Team은 Business Operations & Analytics 조직의 일원으로, 아자르의 제품 성장을 데이터로 뒷받침합니다.
  • 매일 수천만 건의 글로벌 매칭이 만들어내는 데이터를 기반으로 다국적 유저 데이터의 공통점과 차이를 분석합니다.
  • 실험 설계부터 결과 해석까지 분석가가 주도합니다. 대규모 트래픽에서 A/B 테스트를 직접 분석하여 제품 의사결정에 직접 기여합니다.
  • PM, Designer, Engineer로 구성된 프로덕트 스쿼드에 참여하며, 분석 결과가 실제 제품의 변화로 이어지는 환경에서 일합니다.
  • Data Analytics Engineer와 긴밀하게 협업하여 분석 프레임워크와 데이터 인프라를 함께 구조화합니다.

• 프로덕트 스쿼드에 참여하여 핵심 지표를 정의하고, 데이터 분석이 제품 의사결정으로 이어지도록 돕습니다.
  • A/B 테스트를 직접 설계하고, 결과를 다양한 이해관계자에게 커뮤니케이션합니다.
  • 유저 행동 데이터를 분석하여 문제를 정의하고, 제품 핵심 지표의 변화 원인을 파악하여 실행 가능한 액션 아이템을 제안합니다.
  • 신규 기능에 대한 이벤트 로그를 직접 설계하고, 유저 행동이 정확히 측정될 수 있는 데이터 구조를 관리합니다.
  • Airflow 기반 자동화 파이프라인과 Tableau/Data Studio/evidence 등의 대시보드를 구축하여 데이터 활용 효율을 높입니다.
  • 분석 방법론과 베스트 프랙티스를 공유하고, 실험 분석 프레임워크 구축 등 팀 전체의 분석 역량 향상에 기여합니다.

• SQL을 활용한 데이터 분석 경력 3년 이상 또는 이에 준하는 경험
  • A/B 테스트를 설계부터 결과 분석 및 인사이트 도출까지 전 과정을 실행한 경험
  • Tableau/Data Studio/evidence 등의 BI 툴을 활용한 대시보드 설계 및 운영 경험
  • 유저 행동 측정을 위한 로그를 설계하고 데이터 구조를 체계화한 경험
  • 다양한 지표에 대한 정확한 이해 및 상황에 맞는 분석 방법론을 적용할 수 있는 능력
  • 지표의 상관관계와 인과관계를 구분하고 이를 바탕으로 논리적인 주장을 제시할 수 있는 능력
  • 데이터 분석 결과를 다양한 이해관계자에게 명확하게 전달할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 역량

• 실험 분석 프레임워크 구축 또는 A/B 테스트 플랫폼 운영 경험
  • 소셜·커뮤니케이션 서비스 도메인에서의 프로덕트 분석 경험
  • Airflow 등 데이터 파이프라인/자동화 툴 실무 적용 경험
  • 영어 기반 업무 커뮤니케이션 능력

• 고용 형태: 정규직
  • 채용 절차: 서류전형 > Technical Assessment > Recruiter Call > 1차 면접 > 2차 면접 > 최종합격 (*필요 시 전형이 추가/변경 진행될 수 있습니다.)
  • 지원 서류: 자유 양식의 상세 경력기반 국문 또는 영문이력서(PDF)

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect all of us to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.
 
Why Match Group?
 
Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer:
 
Mind & Body – Medical, mental health, and wellness benefits to support your overall health and well-being
Financial Wellness – Competitive compensation, 100% employer match on 401k contributions up to 10% (cap at $10,000), as well as an employee stock purchase program to help you feel supported in your financial security
Unplug – Generous PTO and 14 paid holidays so you can unplug
Career – Annual training allowance for professional development and ERG membership opportunities and events so you feel connected and empowered in your work
Family – Families come in all shapes and sizes so we offer 20 weeks of 100% paid parental leave, fertility, adoption, and child care resources, as well as pet insurance and discounts  
Company Gatherings – We host company events where our employees get to know each other and build a sense of connection and belonging!
 
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we value the rich dynamics that diversity brings to our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation, sex (including pregnancy and sexual harassment), gender identity or expression, uniformed service or veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic.  Period. 
 
If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the hiring process — such as during pre-employment testing or interviews — please indicate this by selecting “Yes” in the accommodation request field. We’ll reach out to discuss your needs if you're selected for the interview stage.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


We're looking for a Manager, Digital & Social Communications to join our team. Our Corporate Affairs team exists to build Match Group’s reputation and promote the category with users, investors, media, policymakers, and current/prospective employees. That means driving investor reconsideration, improving perception of dating apps, and positioning Match Group as the category leader. You’ll own how we listen to, measure, and show up across social and digital channels, bringing analytics, and storytelling (video, corporate website, and blog) to our highest-priority campaigns. 
 
This role is based out of our LA office 3 days/week.

lists.content:
• Own social listening and reputation monitoring (via social listening tools) across earned and social channels, tracking sentiment and coverage for flagship campaigns like the Anti-Loneliness Campaign, Human Connection Hub, and Healthy Dating Campaign, and flagging risks and opportunities to leadership

  • Manage the corporate website and blog as the home for our storytelling, publishing campaign reports (e.g., our economics-of-dating report), narrative pieces, and executive thought leadership

  • Own video and digital amplification plans for major campaigns and executive moments, extending the reach of earned coverage and events (e.g., Healthy Dating Campaign, regional forums, trust and safety campaigns)

  • Support employer brand strategy across social and digital channels, partnering with HR/Talent to spotlight our people and culture.

  • Monitor social and digital sentiment tied to Trust & Safety, policy, and executive reputation moments, providing early warning on emerging issues

lists.text: We could be a Match if:
lists.content:
• You have 5+ years of experience in digital/social media management, corporate communications, or a related field 

  • You have hands-on experience with social listening and analytics tools (e.g., Emplifi, Meltwater, Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Google Analytics) and survey-based measurement

  • You’ve built or supported employer brand strategy and content

  • You have experience managing a corporate website/CMS and blog content

  • You’re comfortable coordinating video production and digital amplification, from creative brief through final delivery 

  • You have strong analytical skills and can turn data into clear, actionable recommendations tied to OKRs 

  • You’re comfortable working across time zones and regional teams (US, Europe, International) to keep measurement and content consistent

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills 

  • You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• Successful individuals in this role are proactive, organized, self-directed, and can prioritize multiple projects while maintaining strict confidentiality

  • We take joy in our work—we’re lucky to tell stories about love and human connection

  • We prioritize proactive storytelling over reactive response, while still knowing how to assess risk and respond calmly when issues arise 

  • We solve problems and assume best intent. We have honest, open conversations with teammates and partners across the business

401(k) Matching: We match 100% of the first 10% of pre-tax 401(k) contributions you make, up to a maximum of $10,000 per year.

Professional Growth: Get an annual Learning & Development stipend once you’ve been with us for three months. You also get free access to Udemy, an online learning and teaching marketplace with over 6000 courses, starting your first day.

#Hinge
descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
Most consumer apps treat your attention as the product, optimizing every recommendation and notification to keep you scrolling. Hinge made the opposite bet: our mission is to get people off the app, out on a date, and eventually to delete us entirely. That is not a tagline. It is the actual constraint every AI system we build has to solve against.
 

The Director of AI, Dating Outcomes owns the hardest version of that problem. You will lead the AI systems at the core of how Hinge connects people: the recommendation engine, the ranking models, and the generative capabilities that help users put their best selves forward. The goal is not engagement, it is outcomes: fewer ratings per exchange, higher quality matches, and more people finding the person they were looking for. Because Hinge does not sell ads or user data, being exceptional at this is our business model. Reporting to the VP of AI, you will set the long-term AI roadmap for one of the company's most influential product areas and build the teams that bring it to life. The problems sit at the intersection of human behavior, sparse real-world signals, and a two-sided ecosystem of people who are not interchangeable, a different kind of ML challenge than most people in this industry have had the chance to work on.

lists.content:
• Strategy and Vision: Own the AI strategy for dating recommendations across the full journey, from first candidate to last date. Build the frameworks to reason rigorously through ecosystem tradeoffs where a win for one cohort reshapes another, and set a vision ambitious enough that the org wants to chase it.

  • Cross-Functional and Industry Leadership: Partner closely with other product groups to integrate AI capabilities across the product and shape roadmap decisions you do not own. Communicate honestly with executive leadership on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress. Own budget and investment strategy for the area, and represent Hinge externally through writing, talks, and community.

  • Technical Leadership: Steer real-time, personalized recommendation systems that reduce ratings per exchange and drive better matches. Bring Generative AI to dating outcomes in ways that are differentiated, authentic, and grounded in how people actually connect.

  • Responsible AI: Hold the bar on scalability, resilience, and rigorous evaluation for both performance and bias. 

  • Team and Organizational Development: Structure and scale the team for both deep execution and long-horizon bets. Develop emerging leaders, invest in succession across IC and leadership tracks, and build a culture where rigor, inclusion, and performance reinforce one another.

  • Execution Excellence: Drive predictable delivery, balancing urgent risk response with long-term platform investments. Establish scalable operating rhythms for planning, technical reviews, and incident learnings.

• 10 or more years across data science, applied ML, and software engineering, with 6 or more years in AI or engineering leadership defining strategy, not just managing execution.

  • A track record of leading real-time, personalized recommendation systems in production, including the relevance, fairness, and scale tradeoffs that carry real consequences.

  • Demonstrated success scaling ML or AI teams and developing technical leaders who carry the work over years, not a single launch.

  • Deep technical fluency across ML, RL, Generative AI, and MLOps, with the communication skills and executive presence to represent AI strategy at the highest levels of the organization.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. A PhD is a plus, not a requirement.

    •  

    What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience building AI systems in a two-sided or constrained marketplace, where optimizing for one group shifts outcomes for another and the right answer is rarely obvious.

  • A history of deploying Generative AI thoughtfully in user-facing experiences, not as a trend to follow.

  • External presence through publishing, speaking, or community contribution that reflects genuine intellectual engagement with the field.

  • Prior work in a domain where user outcomes are high-stakes and hard to measure, whether health, education, finance, or something comparably consequential.

With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
We are hiring a Director of UX Research to lead research across our Dating Outcomes and Platform product areas. You will set the vision and strategy for how research informs product decisions across the core product experience at Hinge, focusing on some of Hinge's most complex research questions – understanding what's getting in the way of people forming real connections, and what Hinge needs to become to fundamentally shift how dating works online. The work is ambitious, high-stakes, and directly shapes how Hinge invests.
 
This is a senior leadership role with significant scope: you'll manage a team of researchers, own the research strategy and roadmap for Dating Outcomes and Platform, and operate as a strategic partner to group-level product, design, data science, and engineering leadership. This is an ideal role for a proven research leader who synthesizes user insights and data science findings into clear product strategy, builds the organizational conditions for teams to execute well, and thrives on ambiguous, high-impact problems.

lists.content:
• Define and drive the UX research vision, strategy, and roadmap for Dating Outcomes and Platform — prioritizing the questions that need to be answered before roadmaps are locked
  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of seasoned, experienced researchers, setting a high bar for craft, rigor, and impact
  • Operate as a strategic partner through synthesizing UXR and DS insights into POVs that shape product vision and strategy and inform executive decisions
  • Represent Dating Outcomes and Platform insights clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, communicating roadmaps, tradeoffs, and product implications
  • Drive cross-team synthesis and frameworks that unify insights across teams and product groups
  • Identify structural and organizational gaps; proactively design ways of working that improve team velocity, cross-functional collaboration, and research quality
  • Build a team culture grounded in curiosity, rigor, deep user empathy – and fun!

• 10+ years of UX research experience in consumer-facing industries, with 4+ years managing and developing professional researchers across multiple levels.
  • Proven track record of leading research across complex, multi-team consumer product portfolios with clear examples of research directly shaping product strategy and measurable outcomes
  • Deep expertise across qualitative and quantitative research methods — able to set the methodological bar across a team, partner fluently with Data Science, and integrate quant and qual into a unified research strategy
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and craft level — setting research vision while holding a high bar for rigor and execution across the team
  • Experience managing and mentoring highly senior ICs — able to establish clear roles and responsibilities, protect independent scope, and support researchers who are deeply embedded in product strategy and operating at a level that may match or exceed their manager's domain depth
  • Demonstrated ability to do the organizational glue work: identifying when teams aren't functioning well, diagnosing root causes, and driving the interventions to fix it
  • Confident, clear communicator who can represent research strategy at VP-level forums, influence without authority across product, engineering, design, and data, and present complex tradeoffs accessibly
  • Passion for innovation and exploring how emerging technologies, including generative AI, can elevate the craft and impact of research
  • Passion for Hinge's mission of helping people build meaningful relationships

descriptionPlain:
At Match Group (NASDAQ: MTCH), millions of members use our products every month and our customers go on tens of thousands of dates every single day. Our reach and impact are staggering. We believe that no business brings more happiness to more people than ours; we can never forget the impact we have on society and most importantly, our community members.
"Pairs" is an online dating app used by more than 27 million people in Japan. Since launch, we have received success stories from over 900,000 people. Pairs is the first-in-market to offer 24/7 in-house customer service, including text and image monitoring, so our users' safety and security are always ensured.
We created Pairs to help singles discover new and interesting ways to find a life partner. In the United States, more than 1 in 3 couples met their partner online. In Japan more than 70 per cent of singles claim to have no partner. As the number one online dating service in Japan, we're working hard every day to help singles find their true love. Since the release of Pairs in October 2012, we have helped create opportunities for many users to find partnership and marriage. Pairs offers the opportunity to find an ideal partner that matches one's own values through various search features and a well-developed MyTag. 
Every day, we receive many reports of successful matches from across Japan and overseas. It is our hope that more and more wonderful relationships will be created, which inspires us to improve our service every day.
Job Summary:
Pairs is looking for an exceptional Director of Brand, Communications & Partnerships to lead the overall Brand function in Japan. This leader will define and execute the long-term Brand Strategy for Pairs while overseeing integrated Brand Marketing, Communications, Strategic Partnerships and Alliance Marketing initiatives.
The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with exceptional execution, possesses a deep understanding of modern brand building, integrated marketing and social-first communications, and has a proven ability to build high-performing teams. This role partners closely with senior leaders across Eureka and Match Group to strengthen the Pairs brand while driving measurable business impact.

Our Accounting team is seeking a Director, Equity Accounting to serve as the definitive leader for the end-to-end accounting, valuation, and forecasting of our global equity incentive plans. This is a high-impact, Dallas-based role where you will act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, ensuring our complex equity structures are technically sound and compliant.

lists.content:
• Strategic Financial Ownership: Lead the end-to-end accounting, valuation, and forecasting for all global equity incentive plans. You are the definitive subject matter expert for ASC 718 and ASC 260 and the primary architect of the equity-related financial statement disclosures.

  • Executive Advisory & Board Reporting: Partner closely with the SVP of Financial Reporting, Legal Counsel, and the People Team. You will prepare and present high-level analysis on plan availability, burn rates, and the financial impact of proposed equity structures.

  • Global Mobility & Tax Compliance: Serve as the internal authority on the complexities of a modern workforce. You will oversee the logic for state and international mobility, ensuring that cross-border tax withholding and reporting are technically sound and compliant with local jurisdictions.

  • Advanced Forecasting & Modeling: Own the "Equity Crystal Ball." You will develop sophisticated models to forecast SBC expense, diluted shares impact, and cash flow requirements under multiple "what-if" scenarios.

  • Audit & Control Leadership: Set the standard for SOX compliance within the equity function. You will lead the relationship with external auditors, defending technical positions on valuations, and award modifications.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the bridge between Finance, People/HR, and Legal. You will be the Accounting voice at the table providing insights into the accounting impact of daily decisions.

  • Team Mentorship: Directly manage and develop a Manager-level professional, fostering a culture of technical excellence, career growth, and extreme attention to detail.

  • Other Areas: ESPP, Section 16 filings

lists.text: We may be a Match if:
lists.content:
• Experience: 8-12+ years of progressive accounting experience, with 3-5+ years specifically focused on equity accounting.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting.

  • Certification: Active CPA is required.

  • Technical knowledge: Mastery of US GAAP, specifically ASC 718 and ASC 260

  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, critical thinking, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

• Public accounting background

  • Certified Equity Professional

  • M&A experience with equity treatment

  • Shareworks and OneStream experience

  • SEC Reporting experience

We're seeking a Director, Global Safety Regulatory Compliance to spearhead Match Group's efforts to ensure portfolio-wide corporate compliance with global regulations focused on online trust and safety. lists.content:
• Work closely alongside Government Relations and Legal teams to analyze current and upcoming global regulations pertaining to trust and safety on dating platforms, maintaining a centralized repository of compliance requirements

  • Socialize information about safety regulations with stakeholders at each of Match Group’s brands, with an emphasis on enabling brand-level innovation and providing ample development runway

  • Delivering written and verbal regular executive-level briefings on regulatory themes and compliance status

  • Manage and iterate on programs to implement regulatory compliance requirements across all Match Group brands, including project plans, timelines, and milestones

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure timely implementation, and report on project status to senior leadership

  • Collaborate with legal, policy, and communications teams on regulatory engagement and advocacy strategy, including input on policy positions and external communications

  • Oversee the delivery and development of transparency reports and other required disclosures, coordinating with data science and analytics leads on data needs

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of compliance activities, including policies, procedures, and audit reports, and conduct regular audits

  • Act as the primary point of contact for regulatory inquiries, drafting responses, coordinating internal resources, and facilitating proactive "no surprises" communication with regulators on new features and developments

  • Manage and develop team members contributing to these initiatives

lists.text: You could be a Match if you have:
lists.content:
• 8–12 years of experience in regulatory compliance, Trust & Safety, public policy, or a related field, including 3–5 years in a leadership or managerial capacity

  • Strong familiarity with major global regulations affecting online trust and safety

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing executive-level briefings and regulator-facing documentation

  • Proven program management skills, including the ability to build project plans, drive cross-functional alignment, and report progress to senior leadership

  • Experience coordinating with Legal, Government Relations, and Communications teams on regulatory strategy

  • Direct experience handling regulatory inquiries, audits, or transparency reporting

  • People management experience, with a demonstrated ability to develop and grow a team

  • High degree of independence, ownership, and judgment in ambiguous, fast-moving environment

descriptionBody:
The Match Group, the absolute category leader in digital dating, is hiring! 

We're looking for a West Coast Account Director of Sales to maximize revenue across Match Group’s properties, including flagship brands Tinder, Match, OkCupid, POF, BLK, and Chispa.

Our team is looking for an Account Director of Sales to represent our leading brands to major ad agencies and clients. Reporting to the Global Head of Sales, the West Coast Account Director will have ownership and responsibility for client and agency relationships in the designated region. He/she will be responsible for helping to identify prospects, securing meetings, presenting our capabilities, and proposing and closing Direct and Programmatic business. This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced digital media seller.

Match Media Group is the marketing and advertising division within the Match Group that builds and offers advertising solutions across category-leading brands focused on singles and first-time connections, including Tinder, Match.com, OkCupid, BLK, Chispa, Plenty of Fish, HER, and over 25 other properties, to help brands and agencies find innovative ways to reach passionate audiences and connect with their consumers.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL in our LA office 3 days/week.

additionalPlain:
Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect all of us to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.
 
Why Match Group?
 
Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer:
 
Mind & Body – Medical, mental health, and wellness benefits to support your overall health and well-being
Financial Wellness – Competitive compensation, 100% employer match on 401k contributions up to 10% (cap at $10,000), as well as an employee stock purchase program to help you feel supported in your financial security
Unplug – Generous PTO and 14 paid holidays so you can unplug
Career – Annual training allowance for professional development and ERG membership opportunities and events so you feel connected and empowered in your work
Family – Families come in all shapes and sizes so we offer 20 weeks of 100% paid parental leave, fertility, adoption, and child care resources, as well as pet insurance and discounts  
Company Gatherings – We host company events where our employees get to know each other and build a sense of connection and belonging!
 
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we value the rich dynamics that diversity brings to our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation, sex (including pregnancy and sexual harassment), gender identity or expression, uniformed service or veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic.  Period. 
 
If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the hiring process — such as during pre-employment testing or interviews — please indicate this by selecting “Yes” in the accommodation request field. We’ll reach out to discuss your needs if you're selected for the interview stage.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


At Match Group, our mission is to spark meaningful connections for every single person worldwide. Across our portfolio of trusted brands, we help millions of people discover, connect, date, and build relationships in ways that reflect their identities, intentions, cultures, and communities.
We work together to solve complex problems at the intersection of human connection, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, safety, privacy, cultural nuance, loneliness, love, sex, and relationships.
As the world’s leading portfolio of dating products, Match Group has a unique opportunity to imagine what comes next for dating — including how emerging technologies can help people feel more understood, more intentional, and more confident as they connect.
The Team
Match Group is building an internal incubation focused on AI-powered dating experiences to redefine the category.
Dating is a deeply human experience, but many of today’s products were built before AI could understand context, intent, nuance, and feedback at scale. We believe there is an opportunity to rethink parts of the dating experience from first principles, combining strong consumer product craft with AI-native systems that help people connect with more confidence, clarity, and trust.
This team will operate like a small startup inside Match Group. We are moving from product hypothesis to prototype to pilot, with the goal of learning quickly from real users and identifying whether there is a new product opportunity that can scale.

lists.content:
We’re looking for a Founding Full Stack Engineer, AI Incubation to be the technical owner for this initiative. 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a Staff/Principal-level engineering leader who can build quickly, make strong technical decisions, and help turn an early product thesis into a working product.

You’ll work directly on the core experiences users rely on to discover, evaluate, and build meaningful connections. You’ll identify where today’s dating experiences create friction, ambiguity, or low-quality outcomes, and rethink how AI can help create a more useful, trusted, and personalized experience.

You should be excited by zero-to-one product building: taking an ambiguous opportunity, defining the fastest path to learning, building the first version, putting it in front of users, and iterating based on real behavior.

• Build end-to-end product experiences that span frontend applications, backend services, agent workflows, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and internal tooling.

  • Design AI-powered systems that help the product understand user intent, reason about compatibility, personalize recommendations, and improve through feedback over time.

  • Partner closely with product, design, and research to rapidly translate insights into prototypes, pilots, and production-ready features.

  • Use frontier AI tools and modern engineering workflows to compress the path from idea to working product, while maintaining strong technical judgment around reliability, privacy, and scale.

  • Instrument the product with analytics, event tracking, dashboards, and experimentation tools so the team can evaluate engagement, retention, quality, and product-market signal.

  • Improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and performance of the systems and workflows you build.

  • Define the early system architecture and technical roadmap, and serve as a strategic technical thought partner to Match Group leadership.

lists.text: We could be a match if you:
lists.content:
• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including experience operating at Staff, Principal, founding engineer, technical lead, or equivalent level.

  • A track record of building and shipping consumer products in fast-moving environments, ideally across zero-to-one, early-stage, or startup contexts.

  • Deep full-stack technical range, with the ability to move independently across product surfaces, backend systems, data architecture, infrastructure, and production operations.

  • Experience with mobile development using React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, or similar technologies.

  • Experience working with modern AI development workflows and practical experience building AI-powered products used by real users

  • High technical judgment around reliability, privacy, security, observability, maintainability, and scale.

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to serve as a trusted technical partner to product, design, research, engineering, and senior leadership.

  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to operate without a large team, detailed specs, or fixed roadmap.

  • High judgment around consumer trust, identity, privacy, and emotionally personal user experiences.

• Experience in dating, social discovery, consumer social, messaging, marketplaces, creator platforms, gaming, community products, or subscription-based consumer products.

  • Experience building AI-native consumer products or AI-powered features used by real users.

  • Experience with recommendation systems, ranking systems, personalization, matching, marketplace liquidity, network effects, or consumer discovery systems.

  • Prior experience as a founder, founding engineer, early startup employee, or zero-to-one product builder.

エウレカは、真剣にパートナーを見つけたいと考えている方に向けた恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営している会社です。
Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,700万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、70万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。
2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを。」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。
 
 
Job Summary: 
 
Trust & Safety Project Teamは、違反行為や悪質な利用からユーザーを守り、Pairsを安心して利用できる環境を構築・維持することを目的としたチームです。検知・予防・調査・対応といったTrust & Safety業務を支える堅牢で拡張性のある基盤を構築し、ユーザーの保護とPairsの信頼性向上を通じてサービスの成長に貢献します。
 
本ポジションは、Trust & Safety Project Teamの一員として、Trust & Safetyプロジェクトに専任で携わるTrust & Safety Engineerのポジションです。
 
具体的な業務としては、検知・調査・対応をオペレーションする社内チームが正確かつ高速に意思決定できるよう、管理画面・オペレーションツール・ダッシュボードといったWebフロントエンドの設計・実装・改善と、これらのフロントエンドを支えるバックエンドシステムの設計・開発・運用を担っていただくことです。現場で得られる知見を生かし、対策の運用効率そのものを引き上げていきます。
 
また、違反ユーザーや悪質なユーザーに関するデータを継続的に確認・分析し、リスクや影響を評価しながら、検知・予防・調査・対応を支える仕組みを高速に実装・改善し、悪質な利用の抑止とユーザーの保護に貢献します。
 
Trust & Safety領域のチームメンバーと密に連携し、現場で得られる知見やデータをもとに、対策の精度や運用効率を継続的に高めていくことが期待されます。これらの取り組みを通じて、ユーザーがPairsを安心して利用できる環境づくりに貢献していただきます。

• 検知・調査・対応を担う社内オペレーションチーム向けの管理画面・オペレーションツールの設計・実装・改善

  • リスクの兆候や施策の有効性を可視化するダッシュボード・モニタリングUIの構築

  • 現場のオペレーション効率と判断精度を継続的に高めるためのUI/UX改善

  • フロントエンドを支えるスケーラブルなAPI・データ処理基盤の設計・構築・実装

  • 検知・予防・調査・対応といったTrust & Safety業務を支える仕組みの設計・開発・運用と、変化するリスクパターンに合わせた継続的な改善

  • ユーザー行動、システムログ、施策結果などのデータを自ら確認・分析し、リスクの兆候や傾向、施策の有効性を評価

  • Trust & Safety領域の関係者、Data Analyst、プロダクトバックエンドチーム、SREチーム、セキュリティチームなどと連携し、品質・パフォーマンス・セキュリティ・運用性を高めながら、不正利用や悪用の抑止、ユーザー保護、Pairsの信頼性向上に貢献

• TypeScriptを用いたWebフロントエンド（SPA等）の実装経験（管理画面・社内ツールレベルの開発を一人称で進められること）
  • 3年以上の商用アプリケーションの実装・リリース・運用の経験
  • AWS/Google CloudなどのPublic Cloud上で動作する商用のWebAPIを構築した経験
  • 開発効率改善やパフォーマンス改善やセキュリティ対応等に強い意欲を持つ事
  • 関係者を効果的に巻き込み、成果を上げるためのオーナーシップとコミュニケーションスキル
  • AI周りのキャッチアップ・学習意欲がある・Coding Agentを使って開発した経験
  • 各種テスト手法についての構築・設計経験
  • Webアプリケーションの商用コンテナイメージの作成〜運用の経験 (dockerfileや必要なmiddlewareのinstallなど)
  • Nginx, MySQLなどWebアプリケーションによく用いられるミドルウェアについての最低限の知識

descriptionBody:
エウレカは、真剣にパートナーを見つけたいと考えている方に向けた恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営している会社です。

Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,700万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、70万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。

2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを。」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。

 

 

Job Summary: 

 

Trust & Safety Project Teamは、違反行為や悪質な利用からユーザーを守り、Pairsを安心して利用できる環境を構築・維持することを目的としたチームです。検知・予防・調査・対応といったTrust & Safety業務を支える堅牢で拡張性のある基盤を構築し、ユーザーの保護とPairsの信頼性向上を通じてサービスの成長に貢献します。

 

本ポジションは、Trust & Safety Project Teamの一員として、Trust & Safetyプロジェクトに専任で携わるTrust & Safety Engineerのポジションです。

 

具体的な業務としては、検知・調査・対応をオペレーションする社内チームが正確かつ高速に意思決定できるよう、管理画面・オペレーションツール・ダッシュボードといったWebフロントエンドの設計・実装・改善と、これらのフロントエンドを支えるバックエンドシステムの設計・開発・運用を担っていただくことです。現場で得られる知見を生かし、対策の運用効率そのものを引き上げていきます。

 

また、違反ユーザーや悪質なユーザーに関するデータを継続的に確認・分析し、リスクや影響を評価しながら、検知・予防・調査・対応を支える仕組みを高速に実装・改善し、悪質な利用の抑止とユーザーの保護に貢献します。

 

Trust & Safety領域のチームメンバーと密に連携し、現場で得られる知見やデータをもとに、対策の精度や運用効率を継続的に高めていくことが期待されます。これらの取り組みを通じて、ユーザーがPairsを安心して利用できる環境づくりに貢献していただきます。

descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
The Head of Product & Tech Operations is a high-impact leadership position designed to own and evolve the unified operating system of our Product and Technology organizations. Reporting directly to the Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO), you will be the primary architect of how we work, ensuring our teams are faster, clearer, and more effective at scale.
 
This role merges Product and Tech operations into a single, coherent organization. Your mission is to eliminate organizational noise and duplication, allowing our functional leaders to focus on long-term strategy and innovation while you ensure the engine of the company runs with world-class precision.

lists.content:
• Own the Product & Tech Operating System: Define, document, and continuously evolve the end-to-end Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) as a single, integrated system.
  • Drive Execution Rigor & Planning: Lead the annual and quarterly planning cycles, ensuring alignment across Product, Engineering, and Design. Force early visibility and resolution of misalignments between cross-functional teams before they impact delivery.
  • Lead Technical Program Management (TPM): Directly lead the TPM organization, overseeing the execution of complex, multi-team initiatives that are critical to the company’s success.
  • Operationalize Innovation: Create the framework that allows high-risk, long-term bets to coexist with immediate delivery pressure without diluting either.
  • AI Tooling Enablement: Drive the strategy for AI workforce enablement to ensure our teams are leveraging the latest technology to improve productivity. Own vendor management and the selection, implementation, and governance of the tooling stack used across the Product–Tech organization.

• Proven Leadership: Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in a senior leadership role within Product Operations, Engineering Operations, or Technical Program Management at a high-growth technology company.
  • Systems Thinking: A demonstrated ability to design complex organizational systems (PDLC/SDLC) that balance the need for discipline with the need for speed.
  • Strategic Execution: Experience leading large-scale annual and quarterly planning processes for organizations with hundreds of employees.
  • Change Management: Proven success in leading organizational transformations, merging teams, or redefining reporting structures and operating models.
  • Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with C-suite executives and SVPs to drive alignment.
  • Forward-Thinking: Experience or a strong interest in AI workforce enablement and modernizing the developer/product manager experience through better tooling.

About the Role 
We’re looking for a Knowledge Management Program Lead to build and scale the knowledge infrastructure that powers Trust & Safety at Hinge. This is a foundational role where you’ll establish the systems, standards, and governance processes that ensure policy and operational knowledge is accurate, consistent, auditable, and accessible across internal teams, vendors, and automated systems.
 
This is a highly cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of T&S Operations, Education & Outreach, Policy, and Product. You’ll transform fragmented, siloed knowledge into a single source of truth that drives enforcement consistency, reduces operational risk, and sets us up to integrate AI effectively into our moderation workflows.
 
This role offers meaningful, direct impact on how Hinge keeps its community safe and is a strong foundation for growth in knowledge strategy, AI integration, or cross-functional program leadership.

lists.content:
• Establish governance models for how knowledge is created, reviewed, maintained, and retired.

  • Design and operationalize a centralized knowledge management system that serves as the single source of truth for Trust & Safety.

  • Own knowledge infrastructure—including platform selection, configuration, and integrations.

  • Implement version controls, logging, and retrieval mechanisms within that infrastructure.

  • Build systems that link policy, guidance, and SOPs to prevent drift.

  • Develop cascading change management processes to ensure downstream updates are triggered and tracked.

  • Support role- and region-based access to knowledge, and align with cross-functional T&S partners on access standards and single source of truth use cases.

  • Build feedback intake systems that leverage QA, user behavior signals, escalations, and operational data.

  • Define and track program success metrics.

  • Continuously improve knowledge quality and discoverability based on data.

• 4+ years of experience in a Knowledge Management program, with a track record of building or scaling knowledge systems in complex, regulated, or operational environments.

  • Strong familiarity with knowledge platforms (e.g., Guru, Notion, Zendesk, CMS tools) and an understanding of their limitations.

  • Expertise in taxonomy design, information architecture, and content structuring strongly preferred.

  • Excellent communication skills—you can articulate complex concepts clearly and succinctly to stakeholders across functions and levels.

  • Analytically minded—you use data from a variety of sources to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.

  • Deeply curious and collaborative—you ask good questions, challenge assumptions, and seek out perspectives that close knowledge gaps.

  • Highly organized and comfortable working independently, with the judgment to escalate issues that could impact program quality or timelines.

  • Passionate about keeping people safe online, regardless of personal familiarity with specific regional norms or cultures.

    •  
    Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Trust & Safety, content moderation, or platform operations.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted moderation workflows and the knowledge requirements they introduce.

  • Background working in cross-functional environments with policy, legal, product, and vendor teams.

  • Experience supporting or implementing knowledge tools for distributed or outsourced operations teams.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


Every month, millions of people come to Match Group's apps to make connections that embrace their sense of identity, purpose, and community. Our Evergreen & Emerging (E&E) division is home to brands like Match, Meetic, OkCupid, and Plenty of Fish, plus a fast-growing set of identity-led apps including BLK, Chispa, Upward, and Salams.

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to drive product vision and strategy across E&E brands like Upward and BLK. We’re looking for an imaginative product leader who can turn deep understandings of specific audiences and their needs into distinctive, compelling experiences. It's a player-coach role: you'll lead a team of product managers, shape end-to-end experiences across iOS and Android, and stay hands-on in execution. You'll partner with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Finance, and Trust & Safety to build distinctive experiences that drive user growth, retention, and revenue.
 
This role is expected to based in our Dallas, TX office 3 days/week. If you are not based in Dallas, we will be offering relocation assistance for this position.

lists.content:
• Define and lead product vision, strategy, and roadmap across E&E experiences, aligned to company goals of user growth, engagement, and revenue

  • Drive product-led growth, owning key metrics including MAU growth, retention, payer conversion, and subscription and à la carte performance

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of product managers, setting a high bar for craft, analytical rigor, and executional excellence

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Brand to deliver high-quality product experiences and drive cohesive strategy and execution across the product lifecycle

  • Leverage the shared E&E platform to ship efficiently, while identifying where individual brands need differentiated, community-first experiences

  • Use data, experimentation, and user insights to inform decisions, prioritize opportunities, and measure impact – breaking big bets into testable milestones and pivoting based on what you learn

  • Champion a customer-first mindset, deeply understanding the needs of the diverse communities our brands serve

  • Balance business objectives with community trust and safety, ensuring a respectful, inclusive, and high-integrity user experience

  • Establish and evolve product processes and operating rhythms that enable efficient, high-quality product development

  • Identify and evaluate new product opportunities, partnerships, and innovations to expand our impact and reach

lists.text: We could be a match if:
lists.content:
• You have 7+ years of product management experience building and scaling high-volume consumer mobile products

  • You have 2+ years of experience directly managing and developing product managers

  • You have experience leading subscription-based or otherwise monetized consumer products

  • You have a strong track record of driving measurable growth across user engagement, retention, and revenue

  • You are highly data-driven, with experience using analytics and experimentation to guide decisions and de-risk big bets

  • You are both strategic and hands-on – comfortable setting vision while also diving into execution details

  • You excel at cross-functional leadership, influencing and aligning stakeholders across multiple disciplines and leadership teams

  • You bring strong product intuition and UX sensibility, with a deep understanding of what makes great consumer experiences

  • You communicate clearly and succinctly in writing and in person, especially with cross-functional partners and leadership

  • You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can balance competing priorities effectively

  • You have empathy for the diverse communities our products serve, and are motivated by our mission to help people make meaningful connections

• You'll lead a cross-functional product team and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Brand, and the broader E&E organization

  • E&E operates as a nimble, mission-driven division within Match Group, combining startup energy with global scale and shared platform leverage

  • The team is highly collaborative, with a strong focus on impact, ownership, and continuous learning

  • Success in this role means building a high-performing team, delivering meaningful product outcomes, and driving sustained growth across the portfolio

#Hinge
descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
Hinge is hiring a Lead Researcher to join our Cultural & Consumer Insights team. This role is the lead quantitative research partner to our Global Communications team, with a secondary focus supporting Product Marketing. This role requires a PhD in a behavioral science field (e.g., psychology, sociology, relationship science, behavioral economics, communications) along with strong quantitative research chops: you know how to design a survey that's methodologically sound enough to stand behind publicly (in press, in reports, in front of leadership), and thoughtful enough to be a genuinely good experience for the daters taking it. You have a proven ability to translate data into insights and stories that provoke new thinking and drive action, and you're energized by the idea of helping daters see their approach to dating in a new light.
 
You'll partner closely with Communications and Product Marketing, translating big, sometimes ambiguous strategic questions ("What is a conversation-worthy behavior amongst GenZ daters") into sharp, actionable survey design and quantitative analysis. One week you'll be uncovering and socializing insights that shape our global consumer reports; the next you'll be partnering with Product Marketing to test feature sentiment or messaging with users. While this role primarily supports Marketing, Communications, and Product Marketing, the insights you generate will often extend well beyond the team, feeding into product initiatives, and will ultimately shape experiences for daters across the globe.
 
This role calls for someone who is highly collaborative, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and energized by moving fluidly between high-level strategic thinking and the technical details of quantitative survey design, analysis, and storytelling.
