  • Design and implement comms strategies that start in social, not end there. 

  • In collaboration with the team, develop and execute influencer strategies and campaigns in alignment with Australia’s overarching marketing strategy and KPIs. 

  • Look for opportunities to hijack cultural moments that are gaining traction on social platforms, through influencer, owned social and comms tactics. 

  • Ensure Tinder narratives are optimised for how Gen Z consumes content: short-form video, creators, podcasts, niche communities, and emerging platforms.

  • Partner closely with local and global marketing teams, to ensure narrative cohesion across paid, owned, and earned channels.

    •  

    Create and drive cultural relevance among Gen Z

    • Shape and amplify culturally resonant narratives that connect deeply with Gen Z audiences — across key social platforms. 

    • You will develop and implement integrated storytelling strategies, with a clear quarterly and annual planning calendar, that transcend traditional press coverage, focusing on influencers and creators to generate community influence and drive relevance and brand reconsideration for Gen Z.

    • Anticipate cultural moments, tensions, and trends to proactively insert the brand into meaningful conversations.

      • Manage Creator, Influencer & Partnership Ecosystems

      • Build and nurture a diverse ecosystem beyond traditional media including creators, influencers, podcast hosts, cultural commentators and community leaders in close collaboration with the local team.

      • Manage local brand partnership strategies and campaigns. Including assessing and managing inbound opportunities, and proactively identifying, outreaching to and nurturing a pipeline of potential partnership opportunities that will help Tinder break-through in Aussie culture, and position the app in unexpected communities or spaces that drive reconsideration.   

      • Manage and evolve agency relationships and external communications support models where relevant.

        • Deliver Measurable Earned Impact

        • While New Users remain the primary MarComms objective, and Active Users the overarching business goal, this role will focus on building measurable earned impact through social media share-of-voice and qualitative and quantitative engagement signals. 

        • In the context of shifting to Social-first, continue to manage and nurture influencers, creators and key journalist relationships, evolving success metrics beyond media coverage volume. 


          •

          Support Brand Reputation & Corporate Narratives

          • Partner with local, regional and global stakeholders on trust & safety, reputational, and corporate communications topics when needed. Helping steward Tinder’s brand reputation across high-visibility moments and evolving cultural conversations.

• Ideally someone with 5-10 years experience in both communications and social media (from an agency or brand background). 

  • A highly strategic yet hands-on MarComms professional, with strong execution capabilities and keen attention to detail. Experience developing and implementing reactive and proactive communications and social strategies end-to-end. 

  • Deeply fluent in social-first ecosystems, creator culture, influencer marketing, entertainment, and digital content trends. With existing relationships in the influencer, creator and media landscapes in Australia, with a focus on Gen Z consumption.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, international organisations.

  • Strong collaborator with the ability to influence across multiple functions and stakeholders. Including experience managing agencies and external partners. 

  • Data-driven with strong commercial awareness and the ability to connect storytelling to business impact.

  • Highly organized with strong prioritization and project management capabilities.

lists.content:
Brand strategy & stewardship

  • Drive development of Match’s brand strategy, positioning, and annual narrative across campaigns, launches, and key member touchpoints.

  • Define the consumer truth for Match, with particular focus on the needs, motivations, and emotional drivers of adults 45+.

  • Write clear, insight-driven briefs that align teams around the audience, problem to solve, and story to tell.

  • Serve as a strong day-to-day brand steward, ensuring Match shows up with clarity, relevance, and consistency across channels and experiences.

  • Close partnership with Research & Insights on understanding core user segments and translating those insights into actionable brand & product strategies. 

    • Integrated marketing & product

    • Lead integrated marketing programs across brand campaigns, product launches & PR moments

    • Partner with creative, social, PR, and external agencies to brief the work, steward execution, and ensure output ladders back to the brand strategy.

    • Work closely with the product team to help shape the product roadmap and storytelling, ensuring features are inherently connected to the brand strategy and are launched as meaningful brand moments

    • Translate brand strategy into product and feature messaging that is clear, motivating, and rooted in member value.

      • Business, data & measurement

      • Manage the brand with a general-manager mindset - tracking business performance, KPIs, and brand health alongside campaign execution.

      • Partner with media and growth teams to connect brand and performance efforts to the same core brief and business objective.

      • Define success metrics, measure performance across brand activity, and use results and learnings to improve future strategy.

      • Bring analytical rigor to decision-making, using qualitative and quantitative inputs to refine investment, improve acquisition efficiency, and drive long-term growth.

• 6+ years of experience in brand marketing, strategy, integrated marketing, or product marketing, ideally within consumer apps, digital platforms, or high-growth consumer brands.

  • Strong experience leading IATs and large scale campaigns from strategy through execution, with strong judgment across creative, channel, and audience decisions.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience partnering across product, creative, insights, media, PR, and growth.

  • A balance of strategic thinking, creative storytelling, and analytical rigor.

  • Experience translating consumer insight into strong briefs, differentiated brand strategy, and integrated marketing plans.

  • Strong understanding of how brand and performance work together to drive both immediate impact and long-term growth.

  • Strong organizational skills, comfort managing multiple workstreams, and the ability to operate with ownership in a dynamic environment.

lists.content:
• Serve as the primary strategic People Business Partner for the E&E Vancouver Studio, supporting leaders and teams across Plenty of Fish, The League, and Finance.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, coaching on organizational design, team effectiveness, leadership capability, workforce planning, and talent strategy.

  • Lead talent and performance initiatives in collaboration with our L&D COE - including calibration, development planning, and succession planning for critical roles.

  • Own standard People processes such as performance management and year-end compensation reviews, partnering closely with leaders to drive fair, data-informed, and strategic decisions.

  • Handle complex, sensitive matters in partnership with Legal, People Ops, and other key stakeholders; spot risks early and coach leaders to address them.

  • Provide hands-on coaching and mentorship to leaders and employees at all levels, reinforcing Match Group leadership principles, values, and expectations.

  • Lead all aspects of employee terminations, voluntary and involuntary, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation for high-risk cases.

  • Lead change management efforts, ensuring people impact, clear communication, and alignment with company principles during periods of growth or transformation.

  • Serve as an ad hoc in-office point of contact for non-E&E employees by partnering closely with the Match Group Central People team to help ensure a seamless employee experience in the Vancouver office.

  • Collaborate with People COEs (Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, Learning & Development) to deliver cohesive, high-quality people programs locally.

  • Own and drive E&E-wide people projects as assigned, partnering with E&E People leadership to scope, execute, and deliver impact at scale.

  • Use data, employee feedback, and business insights to proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Oversee and support local Canadian benefits administration in partnership with Total Rewards and external vendors

  • Own HRIS-related processes (onboarding, offboarding, and core people workflows) to ensure accuracy, compliance, and a strong employee experience.

lists.text: We could be a match if:
lists.content:
• You bring 7+ years of progressive HR / People Business Partner experience, ideally supporting tech, product, or high-growth organizations.

  • You have a proven track record as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders in complex, fast-moving environments.

  • You’re highly skilled in influencing without authority and communicating clearly with executives, managers, and employees.

  • You have deep experience across core People domains, including performance management, talent development, compensation, employee relations, and compliance.

  • You’re comfortable navigating both hands-on execution and strategic ownership.

lists.content:
▪️Own Regional Business Performance & Strategy

  • Act as the primary analytics partner for a region, owning the full-funnel performance narrative (acquisition → engagement → retention → revenue).

  • Proactively identify opportunities and risks within your region and influence business strategy through data-driven recommendations.

  • Drive alignment across Marketing, Product, and Finance stakeholders on key performance drivers.

    •  

    ▪️Lead Complex Investigations & Insight Generation

  • Independently lead deep-dive analyses into significant performance changes, ambiguous trends, or emerging opportunities.

  • Integrate signals across marketing activity, product changes, experimentation results, and user behavior to identify root causes.

  • Define analytical approaches and frameworks for new or ambiguous problem spaces.

    •  

    ▪️Translate Insights into Executive-Level Narratives

  • Synthesize complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives for leadership forums (QMO, WBR, APM).

  • Frame insights in terms of business impact, trade-offs, and recommended actions.

  • Influence decision-making through strong storytelling and structured communication.

    •  

    ▪️Drive Cross-Functional Impact

  • Partner closely with regional marketing leaders, product teams, finance, and data science to shape decisions and priorities.

  • Serve as a key interface between Business Analytics and partner teams, ensuring alignment and clarity on performance drivers.

  • Escalate complex analytical questions and collaborate with Data Scientists on advanced modeling and experimentation.

    •  

    ▪️Establish Best Practices & Raise Analytical Bar

  • Contribute to the development of standardized frameworks for funnel analysis, performance reporting, and investigation methodologies.

  • Mentor and support more junior analysts, helping elevate analytical quality and consistency across the team.

  • Identify gaps in current reporting or analysis and proactively improve processes.

    •

▪️Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related discipline).

  • 4+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis roles.

    •  

    ▪️Analytical Skills

  • Strong experience in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.

  • Proficiency with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Mode, Databricks).

  • Strong understanding of funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and behavioral analytics.

  • Be able to “connect the dots” IE understanding metric relationships and create narratives through data storytelling.

    •  

    ▪️Business & Strategic Thinking

  • Strong ability to connect data insights to business strategy and outcomes.

  • Experience influencing stakeholders and shaping decisions through analytics.

  • Understanding of how marketing, product, and revenue dynamics interact.

    •  

    ▪️Communication & Leadership

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present to senior stakeholders.

  • Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence without authority.

    •  

    ▪️Collaboration

  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills across Marketing, Product, Finance, and Data Science.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


About the team
The Marketing Technology (MarTech) team is a newly formed team building the measurement, attribution, and operations infrastructure that powers user acquisition across Match Group's portfolio of dating apps: Tinder, Hinge, Match, Chispa, The League, Plenty of Fish, and more.
Our charter spans the full path: the marketing and attribution SDKs embedded in the apps, the server-side event delivery that feeds our ad platforms and warehouse, and the tooling marketers use to run campaigns, manage creative, and sync audiences.
About the role
We're hiring a versatile engineer who can work on a mobile platform (iOS or Android)and the backend / full stack. You'll be hands-on in the apps, instrumenting them and building the server-side services behind them, as well as on the marketing operations tooling our teams run on. This is a rare full-spectrum role for someone who genuinely likes owning a feature from the client SDK all the way to the server.
This is a ground-floor opportunity. Because the team is early and serves the entire Match Group portfolio, you'll build the marketing technology that every brand relies on, contribute to the team's foundations and standards as they take shape, and grow your scope alongside the team. You'll also help power our move toward more AI-native marketing operations, building the tooling and agent-ready infrastructure that lets our marketers work in fundamentally new ways. It's a great place to grow: the work has real reach, and there's room to take on more as you do.
Most of all, we're looking for someone who's genuinely passionate about marketing technology: you're excited by attribution, measurement, and the systems that make marketing work, and you want to go deep on the domain rather than treat it as just another stack.

lists.content:
Work on this team spans two broad areas, and you'll move between them as priorities shift:

MarTech implementation - keeping our foundational MarTech stack on the clients healthy and well-maintained:

  • Marketing and attribution event instrumentation in our iOS and Android apps

  • Privacy and consent handling

  • Event delivery that feeds our attribution partners, ad platforms, and data warehouse

    • Marketing operations tooling - building the platforms and services marketers and analysts run on:

  • Programmatic ad-platform management

  • Marketing tooling such as creative management systems and Audience syncing

  • AI/agent-driven workflows and MCP’s

• 4+ years building and shipping production software, with hands-on experience on iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin), including SDK integration and the App Store / Play Store release lifecycle

  • Full-stack / backend experience: building APIs and server-side services in a modern language (e.g. Node, Python, Go, or Kotlin), or a strong foundation and the drive to grow into it

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD

  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous or unowned problems (several items in this scope have no current owner) and drive them to resolution

  • Active, effective use of AI tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) to ramp on unfamiliar code and ship faster

  • Comfort owning your work end to end and moving between the client and the backend

  • Interest in building MCP servers/tools to expose our platforms to Claude and other agents

• Experience across both iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin)

  • Experience with marketing / attribution SDKs (AppsFlyer, Firebase, Adjust, Branch), SKAdNetwork, and the Google Play Install Referrer API

  • Ad-platform APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok) and server-side tracking (Meta CAPI, server-side GTM)

  • Experience building LLM-powered or agentic tooling, including MCP

  • MarTech / AdTech domain background

salaryDescription: The salary range for this position is $180,000 - $215,000.  Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Palo Alto, California. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.

  • Design and deliver leadership development programs for people leaders

  • Facilitate team effectiveness sessions (e.g., DiSC, design thinking) and leadership offsites that strengthen team dynamics and trust.

  • Create scalable, self-serve learning toolkits that meet teams where they are - fast, flexible, and tied to business goals.

  • Partner with People Business Partners and leaders to identify capability gaps and develop solutions to address them.

  • Partner with HRBPs and leaders to embed career frameworks into development conversations and talent reviews.

additionalPlain:
As a member of our team, you’ll enjoy:

401(k) Matching: We match 100% of the first 10% of pre-tax 401(k) contributions you make, up to a maximum of $10,000 per year.

Professional Growth: Get an annual Learning & Development stipend once you’ve been with us for three months. You also get free access to Udemy, an online learning and teaching marketplace with over 6000 courses, starting your first day.

Parental Leave & Planning: When you become a new parent, you’re eligible for 100% paid parental leave (20 paid weeks for both birth and non-birth parents.)

Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
At Hinge, genuine connection is everything — and that starts with the people we hire. As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll own full-cycle recruiting for engineering, product, data, and design roles, partnering directly with technical leaders to build world-class teams. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who operates as a true talent partner — bringing market insight, technical fluency, and strategic thinking to consistently hire technical talent.

lists.content:
Full-Cycle Recruitment

  • Own end-to-end recruiting for engineering, data science, product roles — from intake through offer close, using AI-enabled workflows to drive efficiency at every stage.

  • Continuously refine interview rubrics, technical assessments, and scorecards to reduce time-to-hire and improve offer conversion. 

  • Track and present metrics including time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer acceptance, and hiring manager NPS.

    •  
    Sourcing and Pipeline Development

  • Design and execute multi-channel sourcing strategies using job boards, LinkedIn, niche communities, industry events, university partnerships, and direct outreach to build and maintain a healthy pipeline at every stage.

  • Leverage AI-enabled recruiting tools and predictive analytics to identify and engage passive candidates.

  • Partner with engineering managers to translate technical requirements into creative search strategies, staying ahead of market trends in software engineering, ML, and mobile development.

    •  
    Inclusive Hiring & Talent Attraction

  • Embed inclusive hiring practices throughout the recruiting lifecycle, ensuring interview processes, candidate evaluations, and hiring decisions are structured, equitable, and focused on identifying the strongest talent.

  • Partner with talent communities, professional organizations, and strategic sourcing channels to expand access to underrepresented talent and strengthen pipeline diversity.

  • Champion a thoughtful and consistent candidate experience that reflects Hinge's values and employer brand.

    •  

    Talent Brand & Candidate Experience

  • Act as an ambassador for Hinge, articulating our mission, culture, and value proposition in a compelling and authentic way.

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen employer branding initiatives and attract exceptional talent.

  • Build meaningful relationships with candidates, creating a high-touch experience that fosters engagement throughout the hiring process.

    •  

    Stakeholder and Offer Management

  • Act as a trusted talent partner to engineering and product leaders — translating market data into actionable hiring recommendations, facilitating calibration, and navigating complex technical role definitions with confidence. 

  • Provide offer guidance grounded in compensation benchmarking, internal equity, and candidate expectations. 

  • Maintain clear, timely communication with all stakeholders — candidates, HRBPs, operations team partners, and business leaders — conducting regular feedback sessions with hiring managers to continuously raise the quality of the recruitment partnership.

    •

• 5+ years full-cycle technical recruiting, ideally in tech or mobile-first companies

  • Ability to read engineering JDs, understand tech stacks, and have credible conversations with technical hiring managers

  • Strong command of LinkedIn Recruiter, AI talent platforms, and Boolean search techniques

  • Comfort using recruiting metrics to drive decisions and present pipeline insights to engineering leadership

  • Hands-on experience building technical interview frameworks, scorecards, and assessment rubrics

  • ATS expertise: Hands-on experience with Greenhouse, Lever, or Workday, or comparable ATS platforms.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, comfortable advising senior leaders and navigating ambiguity.

  • High emotional intelligence with the ability to build trust quickly with candidates and business partners.

    •  
    Preferred

  • Knowledge of New York compensation structures and geographic pay considerations.

descriptionPlain:
Our Mission
As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. 
We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.


The Role:
At Tinder we're investing in a new way for our users to spark something new with someone new: IRL events. Events break the dating app paradigm of swipe, match, chat– introducing discovery anchored to real-world experiences, surfacing the coolest events and places in every city with the ability to connect with who’s in the room before, during, and after. 
As Senior TPM, you will own the cross-functional operating model for this fast-paced team, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, BD, Partnerships, Event Ops, and Marketing leadership to bring clarity to ambiguity, structure to rapidly evolving plans and priorities, and deliver incredible user experiences at global scale. 
Where You'll Work:
This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Los Angeles, CA.

lists.content:
• Own end-to-end delivery of the Events product roadmap, including in-app features and operational tooling (event management and publishing), tracking milestones, aligning dependencies, and mitigating risks across mobile, backend, and web engineering teams.
  • Act as the connective tissue across Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, BD, and Event Operations leads to drive cross-functional alignment on the product roadmap and major launches (new markets, new partners, new product experiences),  developing and overseeing project timelines to ensure on time delivery.
  • Define the operating model for the Events program, determining what rhythms, artifacts, and checkpoints teams actually need as the product scales.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues by coordinating with teams to determine solutions and prioritize tasks, while maintaining a high bar for both quality and velocity.
  • Provide clear, timely communications to the executive and senior leadership team on program health, including translating technical tradeoffs and delivery risks into recommendations that shape decisions, not just status updates.

• 6+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, preferably supporting a live events, marketplace, event aggregation,  ticketing, or two-sided supply-and-demand product.
  • Demonstrated success in partnering with both product/engineering teams and business teams (partnerships, BD, marketing), cultivating strong cross-functional relationships and influencing outcomes in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • An ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, an entrepreneurial mindset, and persistent execution.
  • Proven ability to distill complex requirements from multiple stakeholders into actionable project plans. Experience building delivery plans, dependency maps, and risk registers for programs spanning multiple engineering platforms.
  • Proven ability to define and stand up an operating model for a 0-to-1 or rapidly scaling program, not just execute one that already exists.
  • Expert-level proficiency managing cross-functional projects using collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Google Suite, and Figma.
  • Strong track record managing multi-market or multi-region launches.
  • Expertise in agile methodologies and a deep understanding of software development best practices.

• Familiarity with international/localization go-to-market processes.
  • Experience integrating with or managing third-party supply partners via API-based licensing agreements (e.g., content or inventory feeds from external platforms).
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to automate routine program management tasks and accelerate cross-functional communication.

lists.content:
Program & Technical Ownership

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of marketing technology initiatives across mobile, web, attribution, analytics, and data systems

  • Translate marketing and business needs into clear implementation plans, technical requirements, workflows, and rollout plans

  • Partner with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Analytics, and vendor teams to keep complex MarTech work moving

  • Drive prioritization, execution tracking, QA coordination, launch readiness, and stakeholder communication

  • Help make MarTech projects easier to scope, easier to ship, and easier to support after launch

  • Perform troubleshooting and evaluate outcomes post launch to ensure correctness of implementation

    •  

    Tracking, Attribution & Measurement

  • Support and troubleshoot mobile and web attribution implementations across platforms like AppsFlyer, Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and other marketing vendors

  • Investigate issues across SDK implementations, server-to-server integrations, event pipelines, deep linking, consent flows, conversion discrepancies, and attribution gaps

  • Validate tracking implementations across iOS, Android, web, and backend systems

  • Partner with Analytics and Data teams to improve measurement quality, governance, and consistency

  • Help ensure marketing and analytics teams can trust the data they use to make decisions

    •  

    MarTech Operations & AI-Enabled Workflows

  • Support and improve marketing technology infrastructure across client-side tracking, server-side tagging, APIs, vendor integrations, campaign tracking frameworks, and operational tooling

  • Build documentation, implementation standards, QA checklists, and troubleshooting playbooks that make the ecosystem easier to operate

  • Use AI tools and automation to improve investigation workflows, reduce manual operational overhead, and speed up technical troubleshooting

  • Help identify opportunities for better monitoring, internal tooling, and more resilient MarTech operations

  • Make marketing technology systems more scalable, observable, and reliable over time

    •

lists.text: We Could Be a Match If:
lists.content:
• You have 5+ years of experience in marketing technology, technical program management, marketing operations, analytics engineering, solutions engineering, or a related technical role

  • You understand mobile and web attribution systems and know how tracking implementations can break across platforms

  • You have hands-on experience with tools like AppsFlyer, Google Tag Manager, Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Adjust, Branch, or similar marketing and measurement platforms

  • You can work directly with engineers, read technical implementation details, and investigate issues independently

  • You are comfortable debugging tracking, attribution, and measurement problems across multiple systems

  • You can turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, execution plans, and operational workflows

  • You are organized enough to drive complex cross-functional programs, but technical enough to know when the details matter

  • You are comfortable operating in fast-moving environments where priorities shift and systems are not always perfectly documented

  • You are curious about how AI and automation can make technical operations faster, smarter, and more repeatable

• Experience with server-side tagging, SQL, APIs, mobile app event instrumentation, deep linking, MMP integrations, or marketing data pipelines

  • Familiarity with AI tooling, internal automation, or AI-assisted investigation workflows

  • Experience supporting large-scale paid marketing ecosystems

  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure, data warehouses, event-driven architectures, or observability tools

  • Experience working with dating, subscription, mobile app, or performance marketing businesses

lists.content:
As a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM), Security Engineering, you will drive the planning, execution, and delivery of critical security programs and projects across Match Group's full portfolio of brands. You will partner with security domain leads across every function — AppSec, InfraSec, Platform Security, Red Team, SOC, IR, GRC, Data Security, AI/ML Security, and Digital Investigations — as well as brand engineering and product teams to ensure security initiatives land on time, within scope, and aligned with organizational priorities.

This role requires someone who combines strong technical fluency in cybersecurity with world-class program management skills. You will translate strategic security objectives into executable programs, track progress through OKRs and KPIs, and communicate status and risks to stakeholders ranging from individual engineers to executive leadership.

• Drive cross-functional security program execution — own the program lifecycle from initiation through delivery for initiatives that span multiple security domains and brands

  • Partner with security domain leads across AppSec, InfraSec, Platform Security, Red Team, SOC & IR, GRC, Data Security, AI/ML Security, and Digital Investigations to plan, scope, and deliver key projects

  • Manage and report on OKRs and KPIs — track progress against security objectives across the portfolio, identify risks early, and escalate blockers

  • Serve as a liaison between MG Security teams and brand leadership (Tinder, Hinge, E&E, HPCNT, Eureka, New Bets) — ensuring consistent adoption of security standards, tooling, and best practices across brands

  • Coordinate annual security assessments — work with third-party assessors and external penetration testers for evaluations of security posture across brands

  • Facilitate IR tabletop exercises — collaborate with the IR and SOC teams to plan and execute annual incident response exercises (technical, management, and executive levels)

  • Manage security maturity assessments — assess brand security maturity and gaps, develop improvement plans, and track progress toward maturity goals

  • Manage external security scoring — track and drive improvement of the organization's BitSight score, coordinating vulnerability remediation across brands

  • Support vendor security program coordination — work with the GRC team to track vendor security assessments, onboarding, and recertification workflows

  • Provide project management support to internal security teams — establishing best practices for planning, execution, and delivery of security-related projects

  • Create and maintain program documentation — dashboards, status reports, risk registers, and executive briefings that communicate security posture and program progress

  • Manage the Security Mentorship program and support career growth initiatives within the security organization

• 5+ years of experience in technical program management, security program management, or a related role within a technology or security organization
  • Strong technical fluency in cybersecurity — understanding of security operations, application security, infrastructure security, cloud security (AWS, GCP), and datacenter environments
  • Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple teams, brands, or business units simultaneously
  • Experience with security maturity frameworks and assessing organizational security posture
  • Strong stakeholder management skills — ability to communicate effectively with deeply technical security engineers, brand engineering teams, and senior business leadership
  • Experience with project management tools and methodologies (Jira, Agile, OKR frameworks)
  • Excellent data-driven decision making — ability to build dashboards, track KPIs, and present insights to drive action
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating executive-level presentations and reports
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with competing priorities

• Experience in a multi-brand or multi-business-unit security organization
  • Background in the consumer internet, dating, or social platform industry
  • Familiarity with GRC tooling (OneTrust, Monday.com, or similar)
  • Experience coordinating third-party penetration tests and red team engagements
  • Familiarity with AI governance programs and emerging AI security standards (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OWASP AI)
  • Experience managing BitSight or other external security rating platforms
  • Relevant certifications: PMP, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.

Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in Los Angeles, CA, though we also have offices in San Francisco and Palo Alto.

lists.content:
• Support end-to-end delivery for critical initiatives across safety product development, account integrity and identity, anti-abuse detection and mitigation, and moderation operations.
  • Own operational structure and hygiene by establishing consistent standards for tracking product roadmap initiatives, investigation findings, mitigation tasks, and infrastructure adjustments.
  • Partner with analysts, PMs, and engineers to coordinate the end-to-end lifecycle of abuse investigations—from initial detection through investigation, mitigation, and follow-ups—maintaining organizational visibility into progress and status.
  • Identify and coordinate inter-team dependencies while driving launch readiness and rollouts. You will own strategic alignment with key team members, including creating plans, managing risks, and refining communication models to ensure successful delivery.
  • Build and implement frameworks that drive operational excellence, systematically closing gaps and strengthening operational rhythms through subtle, high-impact refinements that don’t disrupt the team’s high-velocity culture.

• 6+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, preferably within Trust & Safety, Integrity, or Security domains.
  • Hands-on experience with high-scale backend systems, distributed architectures, and managing complex technical dependencies.
  • Proven ability to seamlessly integrate into existing team workflows, building trust through collaboration.
  • Demonstrated success in cultivating strong cross-functional relationships and influencing outcomes in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, driven by thoughtfulness, an entrepreneurial mindset, and persistent execution.
  • Expert-level proficiency in managing cross-functional projects using tools like Jira.
  • The ability to synthesize complex technical risks and architecture decisions into actionable insights for less-technical stakeholders.
  • Deep experience creating delivery plans (including identifying trade-offs and managing risks), dependency maps, and release plans.
  • Expertise in agile methodologies and a deep understanding of software development best practices.

• B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Deep understanding of safety reporting, messaging, and account verification workflows in a mobile-first environment.
  • Familiarity with maintaining SLAs for mission-critical safety services.
  • Understanding of system design and the ability to meaningfully contribute to technical discussions.
  • Deep understanding of collaboration management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Google Suite, and Figma.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools (e.g., specialized LLMs) to automate routine program management tasks, improve documentation quality, and accelerate cross-functional communication.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


About the Role
As a Staff Recruiter, you'll lead hiring across our Product, Design, Engineering and Analytics organizations, partnering closely with senior leaders as a trusted talent advisor. You'll help shape hiring decisions by providing market insights, talent intelligence, and data-driven recommendations that enable thoughtful, long-term growth.
This is a highly visible, high-impact role for a recruiter who thinks beyond individual requisitions. You'll influence talent strategy, anticipate hiring needs before they emerge, and bring a strong point of view on how to attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent. Success in this role requires a blend of strategic thinking, business acumen, and the ability to build credibility with stakeholders at every level of the organization.

This role is based out of our Dallas office.

lists.text: How you will make an impact
lists.content:
Talent Strategy & Executive Partnership
 Partner with senior DEPA leaders to develop proactive hiring strategies aligned with long-term workforce plans. Translate market intelligence and hiring data into actionable recommendations, anticipate talent needs before they emerge, and challenge assumptions with data-backed perspectives.

Recruiting Excellence & Process Leadership
Lead end-to-end hiring for critical DEPA roles while continuously improving interview frameworks, assessment methodologies, and hiring processes. Drive calibration, elevate hiring rigor through structured interviewing, and leverage AI-enabled tools and analytics to improve efficiency and decision-making.

Market Intelligence & Talent Mapping
Maintain deep expertise across technical talent markets — tracking competitive landscapes, compensation trends, and emerging skill sets. Conduct talent mapping, execute sophisticated multi-channel sourcing strategies, and regularly brief leaders on market conditions to inform workforce planning.

Inclusive Hiring & Talent Attraction
Embed equitable, structured hiring practices throughout the recruiting lifecycle. Partner with talent communities and strategic sourcing channels to expand access to underrepresented talent and champion a consistent, values-driven candidate experience.

Talent Brand & Candidate Experience
Serve as a compelling ambassador for Match Group — articulating our mission, culture, and value proposition authentically. Build high-touch candidate relationships and partner cross-functionally to strengthen employer branding initiatives.

Offer Strategy & Stakeholder Management
Guide leaders through complex hiring decisions balancing candidate experience, market realities, and internal equity. Develop competitive offer strategies and build strong partnerships across TA, People, Compensation, and business leadership to drive alignment and achieve hiring goals.

• 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting DEPA organizations in high-growth environments, ideally within consumer technology, marketplace, or mobile-first companies

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders through data, market expertise, and strategic consultation, including experience shaping hiring strategy across multiple technical functions and seniority levels

  • Strong sourcing, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement capabilities

  • Expertise in structured interviewing, assessment design, and process optimization

  • Experience leveraging recruiting analytics to drive continuous improvement

  • Strong business acumen and stakeholder management skills

  • Familiarity with modern recruiting technologies, AI-enabled tools, and ATS platforms such as Ashby, Lever, or Workday

  • Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
  • Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


About the team
The Marketing Technology (MarTech) team is a newly formed team building the measurement, attribution, and operations infrastructure that powers user acquisition across Match Group's portfolio of dating apps: Tinder, Hinge, Match, Chispa, The League, Plenty of Fish, and more.
Our charter spans the full path: the marketing and attribution SDKs embedded in the apps, the server-side event delivery that feeds our ad platforms and warehouse, and the tooling marketers use to run campaigns, manage creative, and sync audiences.
About the role
We're hiring a senior, versatile engineer who can work across both mobile platforms (iOS and Android)and the backend / full stack. You'll be hands-on in the apps, instrumenting them and building the server-side services behind them, as well as on the marketing operations tooling our teams run on. This is a rare full-spectrum role for someone who genuinely likes owning a feature from the client SDK all the way to the server.
This is a founding-engineer opportunity. Because the team is early and serves the entire Match Group portfolio, you'll set its technical direction and standards, make the early architecture decisions the rest of the team will build on, and help shape and grow the team as it scales. You'll also help power our move toward more AI-native marketing operations, building the tooling and agent-ready infrastructure that lets our marketers work in fundamentally new ways. As one of the senior technical voices on the team, the work you do here has outsized reach across every brand in the portfolio.
Most of all, we're looking for someone who's genuinely passionate about marketing technology: you're excited by attribution, measurement, and the systems that make marketing work, and you want to go deep on the domain rather than treat it as just another stack.

lists.content:
You'll operate as a senior technical leader here, owning the bigger picture while staying hands-on across the team's work. You'll move between these areas as priorities shift:

Owning the bigger picture

  • Building the technical roadmap for our central MarTech services

  • Defining the architecture other engineers build against

  • Setting the engineering standards for the team

  • Identify opportunities for new systems or capabilities within existing systems.

    • MarTech implementation - keeping our foundational MarTech stack on the clients healthy and well-maintained:

  • Marketing and attribution event instrumentation in our iOS and Android apps

  • Privacy and consent handling

  • Event delivery that feeds our attribution partners, ad platforms, and data warehouse

    • Marketing operations tooling - architecting the platforms and services marketers and analysts run on:

  • Programmatic ad-platform management

  • Marketing tooling such as creative management systems and audience syncing

  • AI/agent-driven workflows and MCP’s

• 6+ years building and shipping production software, with strong experience on iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin), including SDK integration and the App Store / Play Store release lifecycles

  • Solid full-stack / backend chops: building and operating APIs and server-side services in a modern language (e.g. Node, Python, Go, or Kotlin)

  • A track record of setting technical direction, making sound architecture decisions under ambiguity, and raising the bar for the engineers around you

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and working with a data warehouse

  • Comfort owning work end to end and moving freely between clients and the backend

  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous or unowned problems  and drive them to resolution

  • Active, effective use of AI tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) to ramp on unfamiliar code and ship faster

  • Experience building MCP servers/tools, or a strong interest in doing so, to expose our platforms to Claude and other agents

  • Clear communication: you'll work directly with marketers and analysts, not just engineers

• Experience with marketing / attribution SDKs (AppsFlyer, Firebase, Adjust, Branch), SKAdNetwork, and the Google Play Install Referrer API

  • Ad-platform APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok) and server-side tracking (Meta CAPI, server-side GTM)

  • Experience building LLM-powered or agentic tooling, including MCP

  • MarTech / AdTech domain background

lists.text: How you will make an impact:
lists.content:
• Interview Scheduling & Coordination: Own end-to-end interview scheduling across multiple time zones, partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and Executive Assistants to deliver a seamless hiring process.

  • Candidate Communication & Experience: Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates, providing timely communication and ensuring a welcoming, professional experience throughout the interview process.

  • Onsite Interview Logistics: Coordinate onsite interviews, including room bookings, travel arrangements, meals, interviewer readiness, and candidate logistics.

Behind every great hire is a great candidate experience. Our Talent Acquisition team brings exceptional talent into Match, and Talent Coordinators play a key role in making that experience feel seamless, organized, and human. From scheduling interviews to supporting candidates and hiring teams, they help ensure every interaction reflects the care and thoughtfulness that define our brand.

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly organized and proactive Talent Coordinator to support our Talent Acquisition team. In this role, you’ll own interview scheduling, candidate communication, and hiring logistics across technical and non-technical roles.

You'll play a critical role in delivering a seamless hiring experience while helping the team operate efficiently at scale. Beyond coordination, you'll contribute to process improvements, maintain operational excellence across recruiting systems, and help create thoughtful, well-executed experiences for candidates from first touch through offer.

This role is based out of our San Francisco office.

Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect all of us to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.
 
Why Match Group?
 
Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones. Here are some of the benefits we are proud to offer:
 
Mind & Body – Medical, mental health, and wellness benefits to support your overall health and well-being
Financial Wellness – Competitive compensation, 100% employer match on 401k contributions up to 10% (cap at $10,000), as well as an employee stock purchase program to help you feel supported in your financial security
Unplug – Generous PTO and 14 paid holidays so you can unplug
Career – Annual training allowance for professional development and ERG membership opportunities and events so you feel connected and empowered in your work
Family – Families come in all shapes and sizes so we offer 20 weeks of 100% paid parental leave, fertility, adoption, and child care resources, as well as pet insurance and discounts  
Company Gatherings – We host company events where our employees get to know each other and build a sense of connection and belonging!
 
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we value the rich dynamics that diversity brings to our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation, sex (including pregnancy and sexual harassment), gender identity or expression, uniformed service or veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic.  Period. 
 
If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the hiring process — such as during pre-employment testing or interviews — please indicate this by selecting “Yes” in the accommodation request field. We’ll reach out to discuss your needs if you're selected for the interview stage.

Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


About the Role 
As the VP of Product for Trust & Safety at Match Group, you will bring portfolio-level product leadership to our safety efforts across Match Group. You will own the long-term Trust & Safety product strategy and roadmap across our brands and the shared infrastructure supporting them — spanning the systems that detect harm, the tooling our moderation and care teams use, the capabilities that keep us compliant with a fast-moving global regulatory landscape, and the user-facing features that make safety something people can feel.
You will build and lead a central team of product managers, and set product direction that engineering and operations build against. You'll sit within Match Group's central Trust & Safety leadership team and operate across each of our brands — building a deep understanding of each brand’s unique needs and focus areas, and defining a strategy that promotes safe and respectful interactions across our portfolio. Our north-star, and yours, is ecosystem health: whether people are, and feel, safe across every brand we operate.

About the Role 

As the VP of Product for Trust & Safety at Match Group, you will bring portfolio-level product leadership to our safety efforts across Match Group. You will own the long-term Trust & Safety product strategy and roadmap across our brands and the shared infrastructure supporting them — spanning the systems that detect harm, the tooling our moderation and care teams use, the capabilities that keep us compliant with a fast-moving global regulatory landscape, and the user-facing features that make safety something people can feel.

You will build and lead a central team of product managers, and set product direction that engineering and operations build against. You'll sit within Match Group's central Trust & Safety leadership team and operate across each of our brands — building a deep understanding of each brand’s unique needs and focus areas, and defining a strategy that promotes safe and respectful interactions across our portfolio. Our north-star, and yours, is ecosystem health: whether people are, and feel, safe across every brand we operate.

lists.content:
Portfolio Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and maintain the long-term T&S product strategy for Tinder and multiple other Match Group brands, as well as our portfolio-wide central safety infrastructure, in collaboration with brand teams and stakeholders.

  • Deploy user research and a strong focus on our customers to decide what gets built, in what order, and why — prioritizing across the portfolio to build scalable, reusable solutions.

  • Set a clear point of view on proactive and felt safety: intervening before harm occurs, and making protection legible to the people we serve.

  • Serve as an external representative of Match Group and our safety efforts, helping to translate the work we do into a clear and convincing public narrative.

    • People & Organizational Leadership

  • Build, grow, and lead a high-performing central team of product managers across core safety workstreams.

  • Lead through a matrix. You and your team will partner closely with — and often depend on — brand product, design, and engineering teams. Create the working agreements, clarity, and influence that make that model deliver.

  • Build a culture of high standards, end-to-end ownership, and candor.

    • Build-Once Economics & Shared Infrastructure

  • Make portfolio-level build-vs-buy and vendor decisions: where to invest once in shared infrastructure, and where brand-specific solutions are genuinely warranted.

  • Identify capabilities being solved repeatedly across brands and consolidate them into shared services every brand can adopt.

  • Concentrate investment behind the highest-leverage bets, and raise development velocity on what you choose to fund.

    • Responsible AI

  • Champion the thoughtful application of AI across the safety surface — machine learning, LLMs, and emerging tooling — to improve detection and moderation quality, reduce reviewer load, and lower user friction.

  • Drive a culture of AI-enabled development across functions, including building tools and systems yourself and empowering others in Trust & Safety to effectively deploy agentic coding tools and other emerging technologies to accelerate our work.

  • Help deliver on our commitment to AI-augmented moderation and care at scale, without growing cost linearly with volume.

  • Hold the line on the guardrails: accuracy, fairness, privacy, and explainability.

    • Regulatory & Safety by Design

  • Translate a fast-evolving global regulatory landscape — including the EU Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act (Ofcom), Australia's Online Safety Act (eSafety), and emerging age-assurance requirements — into concrete product strategy.

  • Build safety and compliance into products by design, and ensure obligations are met consistently across brands and jurisdictions rather than reinvented for each.

    • Cross-Functional & Cross-Brand Partnership

  • Operate at the executive level across Match Group and its brands, partnering with Engineering, Data Science, Legal, Policy, Operations, and brand product leadership to align priorities and clear obstacles.

  • Surface and resolve the tradeoffs where brand-local incentives (registration, engagement, revenue) and portfolio integrity priorities diverge — and make those calls defensibly, weighing both.

• 10+ years of product management experience in consumer technology, with significant time in Trust & Safety, integrity, or a closely adjacent domain (marketplace, rideshare, gaming, social, fintech).

  • A proven track record of building, developing, and scaling high-performing product teams, with a clear point of view on talent, culture, and how people do their best work.

  • Demonstrated success leading horizontal, platform, or multi-brand product work — building capabilities that serve many teams, not a single product surface.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI and machine learning in a product context. You understand both the possibilities and the guardrails, and you know how to apply each responsibly.

  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous, fast-moving problems — regulatory change, emerging abuse, shifting threat models — into clear product strategy with measurable user and business outcomes.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to lead through influence: aligning brand and central stakeholders, and delivering results without relying on direct authority over every team you depend on.

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the composure to operate in high-urgency, ambiguous environments without sacrificing long-term quality or team health.

  • Deep user empathy and consumer-centric thinking. You believe safety is a felt experience, not only a backend one.

• Experience operating across a multi-brand portfolio, or integrating products following acquisition.

  • Familiarity with non-US safety regulations and cross-jurisdictional compliance.

  • Familiarity with T&S operations, case management, and moderation workflows, and a track record of translating policy into product.

  • Experience partnering with AI/ML teams on detection, classification, or generative-AI risk mitigation.

Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,500万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。(2025年現在)2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版、2025年に韓国版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、100万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。

2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを。」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。

開催日時：
9月9日 (水)・9月10日 (木) 　9:00 開始予定

国内最大級の恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営するエウレカでは、Pairs 2 Days Internship Workshopを開催します。
本インターンワークショップでは、Pairsのプロダクトやマーケティングがどのように企画・実行されているかを実例を交えてレクチャーするほか、学生同士で取り組む実践型の企画ワークショップも実施。テーマは「Pairsの新しい体験を企画し、その価値を消費者にどう届けるか」。チームごとにユーザー理解・課題設定から、機能や体験の企画、GTM戦略・メッセージング設計、プレゼンまでを行っていただきます。
当日は、実際にプロダクト開発・マーケティングを担当しているメンバーがメンターとして伴走。最終プレゼンでは、経営陣を含む審査メンバーからフィードバックを行い、優秀なチームには表彰も予定しています。
将来的に、プロダクトマネージャーやマーケティング、事業企画などの領域で活躍したい方にとって、リアルな現場と実践型アウトプットを通じて、ユーザー理解・課題解決力・企画力を磨ける2日間です。
Pairsの成長の裏側に触れ、自らの可能性を広げたい方のご応募をお待ちしています。
イベント詳細はこちらをご覧ください。


プログラム内容：
ペアーズのプロダクト開発・マーケティング戦略事例のレクチャー
学生チームによる「Pairsの新しい体験と届け方」をテーマにした企画立案ワーク
現場メンターによるフィードバック・伴走支援
最終プレゼン/審査＆表彰（経営陣を含む審査メンバーが担当）
 
本インターンワークショップの魅力：
マッチングアプリビジネスや、Pairsのプロダクト・マーケティングに対する理解を深める
現役で活躍している社員がメンターとして企画立案をサポートするので、ビジネス企画に関する実践的な知識を身につけることができる
参加者の一部の方には長期インターンシップの選考に直結したご案内
企画立案ワークショップで優勝されたグループを最優秀賞として表彰

  • 将来的にProduct ManagementやMarketingのキャリアを志している方
  • マッチングアプリ/恋愛マーケットへの強い興味
  • 英語力：ビジネス上のコミュニケーションに必要な読み書きおよび会話能力

• 論理的に考え、自分の意見を臆せず伝えられる方
  • 枠にとらわれず、面白い発想を楽しめる方
  • チームで議論しながら、より良いアイデアを追求できる方

• 書類選考
    応募時に履歴書またはEnglish CVを添付の上、応募フォームの質問にご回答ください。
  • オンライン面接を実施
• 16名前後・グループワーク形式
イベント詳細はこちらをご覧ください。

text: 長期Internshipに直結！【9月9日(水)・9月10日(木)】Pairs 2 Days Internship Workshop
descriptionBody:
エウレカは、真剣にパートナーを見つけたいと考えている方に向けた恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営している会社です。

Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,500万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。(2025年現在)2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版、2025年に韓国版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、100万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。

2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを。」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。

開催日時：
9月9日 (水)・9月10日 (木) 　9:00 開始予定

イベント概要：
国内最大級の恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営するエウレカでは、Pairs 2 Days Internship Workshopを開催します。

本インターンワークショップでは、Pairsのプロダクトやマーケティングがどのように企画・実行されているかを実例を交えてレクチャーするほか、学生同士で取り組む実践型の企画ワークショップも実施。テーマは「Pairsの新しい体験を企画し、その価値を消費者にどう届けるか」。チームごとにユーザー理解・課題設定から、機能や体験の企画、GTM戦略・メッセージング設計、プレゼンまでを行っていただきます。

当日は、実際にプロダクト開発・マーケティングを担当しているメンバーがメンターとして伴走。最終プレゼンでは、経営陣を含む審査メンバーからフィードバックを行い、優秀なチームには表彰も予定しています。

将来的に、プロダクトマネージャーやマーケティング、事業企画などの領域で活躍したい方にとって、リアルな現場と実践型アウトプットを通じて、ユーザー理解・課題解決力・企画力を磨ける2日間です。

Pairsの成長の裏側に触れ、自らの可能性を広げたい方のご応募をお待ちしています。
イベント詳細はこちらをご覧ください。


プログラム内容：

  • ペアーズのプロダクト開発・マーケティング戦略事例のレクチャー
  • 学生チームによる「Pairsの新しい体験と届け方」をテーマにした企画立案ワーク
  • 現場メンターによるフィードバック・伴走支援
  • 最終プレゼン/審査＆表彰（経営陣を含む審査メンバーが担当）

 

本インターンワークショップの魅力：

  • マッチングアプリビジネスや、Pairsのプロダクト・マーケティングに対する理解を深める
  • 現役で活躍している社員がメンターとして企画立案をサポートするので、ビジネス企画に関する実践的な知識を身につけることができる
  • 参加者の一部の方には長期インターンシップの選考に直結したご案内
  • 企画立案ワークショップで優勝されたグループを最優秀賞として表彰
